notes.title: Update 0.59.7 – Adventure No. 3
notes.notes:
Fighters!
Today we’ve released Update 0.59.7, which introduces a brand-new Adventure and includes a number of bug fixes and improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/e827f3ade38ce7960e0e1c97007fe72fae14d78b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Adventure No. 3[/h2]

The Crab Farm on the Coast was originally intended to be a peaceful initiative… but reality, as always, had other plans. Years of unchecked NDP radiation exposure have led to a full-blown crab apocalypse: crustaceans began multiplying at an alarming rate, forming colonies and perceiving human structures as threats. Even worse, new and aggressive lifeforms have emerged among them - ones no one has seen before… and probably wished they hadn’t.

In this new Adventure, you’ll have to defend a village under siege by armies of mutated crabs. This mission is not for rookies or the faint of heart. Expect chaos, pain, and never enough bullets. Fortunately, several stationary machine guns are at your disposal, but use them wisely - battlefield chaos won’t forgive mistakes. And if all else fails… there’s always the hunting knife. At the very least, it can help you chop up a crab stick salad!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/20e174c8150998047b06ae74aac3a3ab7c5dedb3.jpg[/img]

The rewards for Adventure No. 3 are similar to those from Adventure No. 1, but with key differences. This time, there’s a real chance to obtain the special AS VAL “Adventure” and the Pioneer “Adventure”—we know how much they were missed in the first Adventure. The number of basic repair kits has been increased so you can fix your weapons more often, improving your repair skill at the same time. A new clan quest for completing this Adventure has also been added, awarding PvE points. Additionally, each Adventure now has its own independent cooldown and timeout.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] The location of the Adventure Master has been improved and is now more convenient for players waiting to board the handcar.
[*] Fixed issues with firing animations on stationary machine guns.
[*] Added a clan quest for completing “Adventure No. 3.”
[*] Equipment charging mechanics have been reworked; notifications now appear during the charging process.
[*] Fixed a bug where discharged equipment (such as MRP and MHP) would still display a dome upon re-entering the game.
[*] Fixed several issues that were causing the game client to crash.
[*] Added tips for selecting server types: useful for new players.
[*] A progress indicator now appears in the quick access slot while reloading a weapon.
[*] A quick disband option has been added to the PDA for groups.
[*] The “Machine Oil” quest can now be canceled. This is helpful for Black Sunset players who joined the faction but didn’t complete their tasks in Solnechny.
[*] A new settings option has been added: “Animation Quality” — set to “Medium” by default.
This setting affects animation smoothness when many objects are present in the frame (players, mobs, effects). Higher settings maintain smooth animations longer under load but increase system demand.
This option is especially useful during large-scale battles, such as in Adventure No. 3, where many mobs can cause performance issues on lower-end PCs.
[b]Important:[/b] Changing this setting requires restarting the game client.
When set to “Low,” animations will be simplified and may appear choppy, but the load on your system will be reduced.
[*] Updated hack codes for the “Command Core” in the “Canyon” and “Testing Grounds” locations.
[*] Fixed numerous small bugs and design issues in various locations.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.59.1 – The Adventures Continue!
notes.notes:
Good day, fighters!

Welcome update 0.59.1! Stock up on burn ointment — you’ll need it more than ever because this update brings something new and hot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/2f1080d845ab4beb48cb36eb1b8ddbbeff360cd2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Adventure Master[/h1]

In the remote corners of the “Tunnels” location, you can now encounter the Adventure Master. He is ready to take you on a journey aboard his railcar, sending you on a distant adventure in search of unique experiences, freebies, and riches!

In the first adventure (and there are more to come!), you’ll have to fight your way through portals, battling hordes of monsters, until you finally come face to face with the fiery embodiment of terror—the Gibliont!
To embark on an adventure, players must apply through the Arena Master. For this, we have created a special interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/0cb1f58e93caab673acfb46348be33d9152c1e22.jpg[/img]

Characters who have already participated in the event are automatically placed on a blacklist for 24 hours and cannot reapply for the same adventure. Players who have applied but did not make it into the adventure can simply wait for the next group—no need to submit another application. However, to avoid missing your turn and ensure your departure, you must stay in the “Tunnels” location and keep an eye on the recruitment process.

[b]Requirements for Adventure #1:
[/b]
• Character Level: 20-50
•	Minimum Players Required: 15
•	Maximum Players Allowed: 20
•	Adventure Participation Limit: 1 time per day per character

During the adventure, players can earn a variety of consumables and useful items, including repair kits to restore weapons and armor after battles, as well as improve repair skill.

But that’s not all! Among the rewards, you may also find weapons such as the VSS “Vintorez”, “Zastava”, SPAS-12, and UMP, all featuring unique M3 modifications.

Modification parameters of these guns are dynamically generated, making each weapon unique in its characteristics. Furthermore, these weapons can be upgraded (M6 and beyond), allowing them to remain relevant even at higher levels, competing with level 35 weapons. At the same time, they are cheaper, easier to maintain, and use more accessible ammunition.

Please understand that this adventure may contain bugs, minor issues, and potential balance adjustments. However, in our opinion, its difficulty level is not excessively high, so complaints like “this is impossible to complete” will not be considered.

[h2]Enhanced Recoil Animations[/h2]

Our team agrees with players that hip-fire shooting in the game was overly simplified, making weapons feel weightless and the mechanics too casual. While we recognize that some players prefer this style, we decided to listen to the part of the community that seeks a more realistic and tactile combat experience.

[previewyoutube=OQolM663Pvs;full][/previewyoutube]

As a result, we have reworked the shooting animation. Now, it features a more noticeable visual recoil, making it feel much heavier and impactful, rather than resembling shots from a water gun. This adjustment affects all weapons in the game.

Additionally, we have improved burst-fire efficiency for most automatic weapons. The first 2–3 shots will now have maximum accuracy with minimal recoil buildup and spread. This change ensures that firing in short bursts remains highly effective.

We hope you enjoy this update, and that these animation improvements positively enhance your gameplay experience!

[h1]New In-game Store Design & New Armor Set[/h1]

In this update, we have significantly redesigned the in-game store, making it more user-friendly for navigating through categories. We’ve also introduced several useful improvements, including one-click purchases and other small tweaks to enhance overall convenience and usability.

Additionally, a new affordable armor set, the “Newbie Biker Set”, has been added in several color variations. This set is designed for players who have reached level 7 and serves as an excellent alternative to the “Gorka” suit. It offers slightly improved environmental protection and significantly reduced wear and tear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/33addbad467eedd786bb2b843235567f829a2bf6.png[/img]

[h1]Rewards Balance in the “Foothills” Location[/h1]

We have made improvements to the reward system for the losing side in battles within the “Foothills” location. Previously, players who lost a match could receive only 30% of the total reward pool, calculated based on the points they earned. Now, this rate has been increased to 60%, ensuring that players receive fair compensation for their efforts, even in defeat. We believe this change will boost player motivation, especially for those who previously lost interest in battles, and will make fights more fair and intense.

Additionally, the list of allowed equipment for placement in the “Foothills” has been adjusted: only caches (including premium ones), MHP, and mortars can now be deployed. Other equipment, including campfire kits, is now prohibited.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

	• A cat has been added. You can pet it.
	• Radios in settlements can now be turned on and off. If it’s bothering you, just walk up and switch it off.
	• Improved terrain in the “Eastern Territories” location in the habitat area of Armaturich: more vegetation has been added, making it less barren.
	• Fixed design issues in the following locations: “Testing Grounds,” “Minaev’s Territory,” “Swamp,” and “Foothills.”
	• Optimized light sources in the “Tunnels” location and added lighting at the quartermaster’s station in “Minaev’s Territory.”
	• It no longer rains inside Uncle Borya’s bar.
	• The reconnaissance drone no longer triggers MON-50 mine detonation when flying nearby.
	• Reworked RPG-7 animations.
	• Adjusted RPG-7 reticle.
	• Fixed issues in the Chinese localization.
	• Fixed a bug where backpack straps were not properly colored on female characters of the “Prospector” class.
	• Improved female character models.
	• Fixed issues with simultaneously using a stationary machine gun and a motorcycle.
	• Corrected minor typos in Russian quest texts.
	• Fixed the star display on the “Parade Ushanka” for female characters.
	• Improved NPC animations (merchants and others) — they now look at the player and appear more lifelike.
	• Fixed numerous minor bugs and inconsistencies.

The servers will be taken down for the update. Don’t forget to update your game client!

notes.title: Update 0.58.12
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/1eac705f911cebe1654281ddd5e7e9a6d6b3df95.jpg[/img]

Good day, fighters! 

The Lunar New Year sale and event have come to an end. We hope many of you managed to complete the Old man’s tasks, as with today’s update, he leaves the game, and all thematic items—fillers, fireworks, and others—disappear along with him.

Alongside this, we’ve prepared several improvements already waiting for you in the game! 🚀

[h2]Improvements in the "Foothills" Location[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/febd4f82050530df395cc78a031998d06a99a709.jpg[/img]

The "Foothills" location has received significant updates! In the control point capture zones, we’ve added many new objects, cover spots, buildings, and elevation changes, making battles even more exciting!
We’ve also fixed a number of minor design flaws: removed unnecessary rocks in some areas, revised the spawn points for "Radio" anomalies, and made other improvements.

Work on the location continues, and there’s still a lot of exciting stuff to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/ae98726fd78ede90fb860844973acb176cb487eb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Updated Rain[/h2]

In this update, we’ve reworked the rain: removed the so-called "spaghetti" effect, made the ground wetter, and added more realism. The final result is atmospheric and perfectly captures the grim spirit of the post-apocalypse! 🔥🤗

[previewyoutube=3bisbE595sQ;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s worth noting that the new rain, despite its higher-quality implementation, doesn’t require more resources than its previous version. If we observe 100 FPS without rain on our test configuration, with rain in the same place and at the same time, we get 95 FPS, which doesn’t critically impact performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/f68aaa18c9956729b31eaf11ab1e25ebb8ba0b1b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/f3d7c4426c51db72134ed9d9705bc0bba735d83c.jpg[/img]

Test configuration:

• Graphics Quality: 2560x1080 Ultra
• AMD FSR: Off
• CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 5600
• GPU: Nvidia GeForce 3060
• RAM: 16 GB

Please note: if TemporalAA anti-aliasing is turned off in your graphics settings, the rain may appear "rougher" than when it’s enabled.

Additionally, due to the nature of AMD FSR upscaling algorithms, the rain may not display perfectly when FSR is enabled. This is a natural and expected phenomenon related to how the technology works.

[h2]Faction Chevrons[/h2]


The system for obtaining faction chevrons has been changed. Now, if you’re supposed to receive a chevron for killing a faction enemy, you don’t need to loot the backpack—it will automatically appear in your inventory (if there’s free space). Essentially, the game now has "auto-loot" for chevrons, which significantly simplifies clan progression and the completion of clan quests. Additionally, chevrons obtained this way no longer drop upon character death.
However, restrictions on interacting with chevrons have been introduced: they cannot be traded with other players, exchanged in barter, dropped on the ground, placed in regular stashes, sold, listed on the commission, etc., but they can be destroyed. This means that clan development will now rely on a more convenient way of collecting chevrons and completing clan quests, rather than trading them.
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

•	Added new objects to the "Solnechniy Outskirts" location. We continue to enrich the game world, making it more interesting.
•	Fixed issues with the "Foothills" sublocation loading while using a drone. This time, completely.
•	Improved the sandstorm mechanics in the "Canyon" location. Fixed the issue where the storm would stop if the character took cover.
•	Reduced the blast radius of RPG projectiles.
•	Fixed various minor design errors in different locations.

Please update client of the game!

notes.title: Update 0.58.10 - Lunar New Year Sale
notes.notes:
Good day, fighters!

Today, we have released update 0.58.10, which fixes numerous bugs, adds new quests, and launches the Lunar New Year sale!

[h1]Lunar New Year[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/6425abf65acba74cdce5ae0611e57f73958a3aa9.jpg[/img]

The Lunar New Year sale has already begun! Along with it, the Old Man in White Robe has appeared in all settlements of the Will To Live Online world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/73a8a9bd48c7a4e14bddab6db69bcc4cb20f0f0b.jpg[/img]

By completing the Old man’s tasks, you can earn premium paint cans representing the five elements: fire, metal, water, earth, and wood! These cans can be applied to weapons such as the MSR-10, MSR-12, L96A1, Vepr-12, and PDW. To appease the elemental spirits and obtain the paint, you’ll need to find fillers and create fireworks. Fillers can be exchanged with the Old man.

You can collect fillers until February 9 inclusive, Moscow time (more precisely, until February 10 at 03:00 Moscow time). After the event ends, all fillers will be removed from the game.

[h1]Lunar New Year Sale[/h1]

With the start of the sale, a new item has appeared in the in-game store—a beautiful solution to any verbal disputes: the Golden Knuckle! In honor of the sale, it’s available at a great discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/a00b801a0ebdc3aec5c0546deb32089436afaeb4.jpg[/img]

[b]List of categories included in the sale:[/b]

[list]
[*] Golden Knuckle
[*] Lunar New Year items (paints, paint sets, and snack sets)
[*] Premium weapon paint
[*] "Master" repair kits for weapons and clothing
[*] Mopeds
[*] Gas masks
[*] Pickaxe
[*] "Udav Special" bundle
[/list]

[h1]List of Game Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Several quests (notes) have been added to the bus station in the "Eastern Territories" location. These quests are designed for players level 16 and above and have no special requirements.
[*] A new NPC has appeared in the "Black Sunset" camp. Quests for this NPC will be added in future updates. He’s not very welcoming.
[*] Minor design errors in the "Foothills" location have been fixed.
[*] Drones can no longer be launched in bad weather (heavy rain or sandstorms).
[*] Fixed an issue with the "Big Matador" event in the "Canyon" location, where using an RPG allowed players to complete the event too quickly.
[*] Improved character death animations. We’ve added more physical interaction to them.
[*] Improved death animations for characters killed while riding a motorcycle.
[*] According to our statistics, the "Symbiont" event in the "Bunker" location is too easy. Despite level restrictions, players are completing it too quickly. We’ve decided to double the Symbiont’s health and increase its armor. The event is now available for players before level 40  (previously level 30).
[*] Character death now causes a slight feeling of hunger. As you know, food can not only restore health but also increase its maximum (until the first death). This change will allow players to use food after each death.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] The balance of RPGs and MON-50 mines has always sparked heated discussions in our community, so we’ve made the following changes:
[*] Significantly increased the cost of RPG ammunition.
[*] Reduced the chance of RPG ammunition dropping from NPCs in the "Proving Grounds" location.
[*] MON-50 mines now require character level 20.
[*] MON-50 mines now cost 1500 tokens.
[/list]

The update is now available for download—update your game client!

notes.title: Update 0.58.7 – Armor Modification
notes.notes:
Greetings, Fighters! 🫡

Update 0.58.7 is now available for download, bringing new features and various improvements. Let’s dive into the details. 💥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/58d03937d122030bb5288c2079d1e21a7fdc913c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Armor Modification[/h2]

In this update, we’ve introduced the ability to modify your clothes, enhancing your protective stats. You can modify any piece of your equipment: helmets, body armor, pants, and boots. Even non-faction armor is eligible for modification. If you wish, you can even modify felt boots! However, an exception applies to armor plates — they cannot be modified. 🛡️

To modify any part of your equipment, you’ll first need to craft a clothing modification kit. Be warned: crafting a modification kit is no easy task—it demands skill, determination, and absolutely no tolerance for weakness! ⚒️

Before creating a clothing modification kit, you’ll need to acquire the recipe for crafting one. This recipe can be found with some chance in airdrops. Once you’ve obtained the recipe and installed it in your PDA, you’ll need to gather all the required components to assemble the kit. Two new items are now included in the list of required materials: Clothes  Modification Blueprint and Armor Modification Parts.

	•	Clothes Modification Blueprint can be acquired by successfully completing Matador Events in the “Foothills” location.
	•	Armor Modification Parts are rewards for participating in blockpost defense battles in the “Foothills.” They are included in the loot for successfully capturing a blockpost.

Each kit applies two modifications simultaneously, altering the armor stats and durability. You can apply a maximum of two kits per piece of clothing, allowing up to four modifications (M4) per item.

Typically, applying a kit will enhance the protective stats of your gear at the expense of durability. However, in some cases, both protection and durability can improve. The maximum possible enhancement for armor stats is 20%. 

[h2]Foothills Location[/h2]

Significant updates have been made to the scoring system in this location. The system is now more adaptive, rewarding players with more points on average for actions that benefit their faction. Additionally, we have substantially reduced the point requirements for rewards from blockpost captures—nearly by half. At the same time, we’ve reworked the configuration and content of these rewards, introducing armor modification kit parts, along with repair kits for weapons and armor. This change aims to help players partially restore their equipment after intense PvP battles. Also we’ve increased points accumulation Speed during capturing.

Overall, the reward system in the Foothills has become more generous and fair to players who actively participate in faction conflicts.

We’ve also adjusted the prices offered by traders at blockposts in this location. Now, trading and selling loot to these merchants is as profitable as it is in the Canyon location. 💰

[h2]Recon Drone[/h2]

This version introduces numerous improvements to the drone control interface, enhancing the marker system and enemy scanning functionality. Additionally, we’ve added the ability to repair drones independently using iSAAC through the character’s inventory. You’ll no longer need a second engineer to fix your drone, though repairs now consume more iSAAC.
Key changes include:

• The quick-access panel now indicates whether the drone is equipped with a grenade.
• Friendly drones show a green indicator during target scans, while enemy drones show red, making it easier to identify who is conducting reconnaissance.
• The drone control tablet now displays your group members, improving coordination during group activities.

To balance the simplified repair mechanics, drones now take significantly more damage from other players, meaning they can be destroyed much faster. If an opponent destroys your drone, it will no longer return to your inventory—it will be permanently lost.

Additionally, the number of points earned by drones during blockpost captures has been reduced. While we’re glad to see players utilizing drones for their excellent point-earning potential, they should not become the sole strategy for amassing large amounts of points.

[h2]Miscellaneous Changes[/h2]

In addition to armor modifications, this update brings a range of significant changes aimed at enhancing gameplay and balancing the game:

	•	Adjustments to .308 M1/S1 Ammunition: In version 0.58.2, penetration was increased to 98 (up from the original 85). In this version, penetration has been reduced to 90, as the Mercenary class had become overly powerful at medium and close ranges. This change is expected to affect combat between Mercenaries and Miners, especially with the introduction of armor modifications. However, the impact on other classes should be minimal due to their use of light and medium armor.
	•	Reduced Recoil for MSR-10: While penetration has been slightly decreased, shooting performance has been improved.
	•	Increased PvP Damage for MSR-12: This adjustment aims to make the rifle more viable in PvP scenarios.
	•	Reduced Initial Bullet Velocity for 12-Gauge Ammunition.
	•	Grenade Skill Enhancements: Upgrading your grenade skill now affects not only throw accuracy (even for smoke grenades) but also damage. A mastered grenade skill ensures more consistent damage close to the maximum.
	•	Soon will be added a new Grenade - RG-60TB: This thermobaric grenade completely ignores armor but lacks shrapnel damage and includes a burn effect.
	•	Fixed an issue where leg fractures were not applied after grenade explosions.
	•	Airdrop Content Update: Added a new module with PDA recipes required for crafting armor modification kits.
	•	Female Character Models: Resolved several issues with animations and visuals.
	•	Target Marker Duration: Marker lifespans have been reduced to reflect their rapidly changing relevance.
	•	Stationary Machine Guns: Players can now aim while using these weapons.
	•	Minor bugs in various locations and issues with certain materials have been fixed.
	•	Dynamic Lighting Option: The “Full Dynamic Lighting” setting in graphics now toggles dynamic shadows in the game.

These changes, while diverse, aim to improve gameplay balance and quality across various aspects of the game.

This version includes numerous fixes in the “Foothills” location, a new object added to the “Eastern Territories”, voice lines for certain NPCs, the resolution of many additional bugs, and a variety of other improvements.

Have you encountered the Hellbiont recently?! Well, fighters, the Hellbiont who broke free earlier has gained unprecedented power and has become a truly formidable opponent! He is now a seasonal world boss, much like RW-01 and the Frost Deer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/afb6bb4e646ecf57cbcf6b8c96a037402ea3a530.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/568d2e64ac5daabb6674a16ef1ae92893eeb6d6c.jpg[/img]

- MSR-10
- MSR-12
- L96A1
- WSC PDW
- Vepr-12
- M16
- Thunder
- Pioneer
- SMG-90
- SPAS-12
- Zastava M70
- AS VAL
- VSS Vintorez
- UMP
- MP-5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/9ebac1069b4887723b1b591ba97d43cafd8c2ecf.jpg[/img]

Weapons painted with this spray can be stored in the account inventory. The full list of items that can be obtained from Mr. NukePumpkin is as follows:

- “Skull” mask
- “Toxic Pumpkin” mask
- “Pumpkin” mask
- “Brutality” bat
- Sterilizer

A new “Golden Skull” mask has also appeared in the in-game store, which cannot be exchanged for cards (or “farmed”). It is a luxury item for collectors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/12e8856a0266fe2dab854ed4e5a027a5597f0f54.jpg[/img]

By the way, the Hellbike is no longer available for purchase or for exchange with cards. Our approach is that many players already own this moped, so it’s no longer a true rarity. 

The event will last until November 8, 2024 (inclusive) at UTC. After that, Mr. NukePumpkin will remain for a while so you can exchange your gift cards.

[h1]Bus Station[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/4e876e448dde88ebb47bdcac0b60e1ed29a58a88.jpg[/img]
In the “Eastern Territories” location, a new landmark has appeared – the “Bus Station.” This area is notable for the fact that you can find some rare items here, which aren’t easy to collect and are essential for completing certain quests. Which items can be found there and which quests this area will help complete are details yet to be discovered by experts in the world of WTLOnline.

We also plan to add a few new quests to the “Bus Station” in the future.

[h1]NPC Voiceover[/h1]

We’ve enhanced the voiceover for NPCs in the “Camp” location, which is at the very start of the game, and now nearly all NPCs in the “Camp” have voices. Additionally, all Guide NPCs in the game and Mr. NukePumpkin have been voiced. We plan to continue developing this feature as much as possible to make the game world even more immersive.

[h1]Miscellaneous Changes[/h1]

- You asked, and we delivered! Protection against “logout abuse” was added to the “Canyon” location, similar to the system in the “Foothills.” In this update, players who log out in specific areas will be returned to A1-1 from the Northern Outpost or G4-6 from the Southern Outpost.
- Another popular request: mortar shells are now available from traders at the entrance to the “Foothills” location.
- The weapon description system now omits the “unsuitable for your class” message; instead, if your class has specific advantages with a weapon type, it will display “Your class has advantages with this weapon.” This better emphasizes weapon flexibility without class restrictions, while clarifying class-specific benefits.
- Heavy pickaxe attacks have been reworked.
- Each point of agility now impacts pickaxe strike speed more significantly, speeding things up a bit.
- Over 30+ bugs and issues identified in the “Foothills” location have been resolved.
- Collision issues with certain vehicle models have been fixed.
- Loot in the “Foothills” location was adjusted: was added loot behind lockpicked doors and replaced some ammunition for better balance.
- Design issues in the “Big Village” location have been fixed.
- Minor design errors in the “Sunny” location have been corrected, and several objects reworked.
- Minor errors in the “Camp” location have been fixed.
- Fixed an issue with drone weight increasing after grenade drops.
- Eliminating a character with a grenade dropped from a drone now completes the clan quest requirement.
- Fixed issues detecting enemy equipment during drone-assisted area scans.
- Scanning enemies with a recon drone now grants more points (though limited to prevent maxing out points just from scanning).
- Fixed a bug allowing the drone to be hidden via the quick access panel.
- The Giant Cave Spider in “Eastern Territories” now has simplified requirements to trigger the event.
- If a character is wearing a gas mask, sound effects for taking damage now reflect the gas mask effect.
- Faction changes now reduce reputation with the Roaming Trader less drastically, enabling normal respawning at faction-safe zones.
- Dropped items no longer disappear immediately upon character death. However, please remember the drop feature is intended for discarding items, not trading; use barter for exchanges.
- Adjustments were made to mob spawn settings.
- The level of a mob now displays in the mob search window.
- Fixed an animation bug for the MP-5.
- MSR-12 now supports PO-2 scopes.
- Additional background options (besides the rug) have been added to the weapon preview window.
- For convenience, the Premium Status expiration date now appears in the upper-right corner of the character lobby window if Premium is active.
- Materials for certain objects were improved.
- The “Pumpkin” mask can now be placed in the account inventory.
- A “Create Character” text was added in the character selection window if there are free and available slots.
- Other bugs were fixed.
- New bugs were added.

notes.title: Update 0.58.3 - "Foothills" Location
notes.notes:
Greetings, fighters!

Today, we’ve released the long-awaited update 0.58.3, which introduces a new battleground for faction warfare—the "Foothills" location!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/cbe3757f76c230cd12c958a34bdfecd64256004f.jpg[/img]

[h1]"Foothills" Location[/h1]

[previewyoutube=QbIcKkNIwxc;full]https://youtu.be/QbIcKkNIwxc[/previewyoutube]

With version 0.58.3, faction warfare moves to the "Foothills" location. This area is rich in titanium deposits, a valuable resource for gunsmiths and advanced armor manufacturers!

Access to this location is granted to players in factions who have reached level 30. To participate in battles in the "Foothills," speak with your faction’s recruiter in the "Tunnels."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/bc9f0c7d040cd1927d8b99a3969bd4ec65dfd2bd.jpg[/img]

[b]The location introduces entirely new rules to faction warfare. [/b]Players from both factions are symmetrically positioned on opposite sides of the map, effectively eliminating "respawn wars." Players no longer need to use jammers or hack the command core to capture an outpost. Engineers can breathe a sigh of relief: they can now fully immerse themselves in the real combat missions assigned by their faction!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/b7f6a6300288cb52eb853e4398baa26dcd398afe.jpg[/img]

All you need to do is capture and hold control of radio towers A, B, and C to secure the outpost in the northeast, and towers D, E, and F for the outpost in the southwest. Once your faction gains an advantage by capturing more towers, your faction starts earning points. The faction that accumulates points faster becomes the winner. But don’t relax just yet, fighters! Just because you’ve captured several points doesn’t mean you won’t lose them: the enemy can regroup and take control of the towers from you! If that happens, your points will stop accumulating, and your opponent’s points will start to rise instead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/1e08bfa76e486997368b7a5f026d4d6fad488c0a.jpg[/img]

Note that using MRP and campfires is not allowed in this location, but if one of the radio towers is captured by your faction during the battle, you can use the CCD—the connection to the tower is established upon capture, allowing you to teleport! However, use this feature wisely, as the CCD now has a cooldown period. A poorly timed teleportation can lead to a tactical disadvantage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/e89f3d5f13679918d4ef0d36119766a24398d1e2.jpg[/img]

Along with this location, a new type of weapon has been added to the arsenal of faction players: mortars. Mortars require the clan technology "Faction Arsenal 2." With mortars, you can carry out "artillery preparation" on the radio towers before storming them, or disrupt an enemy’s attempt to capture a tower.

To use a mortar, you’ll need to set it up, prepare the necessary amount of ammunition, calculate the distance, and understand the direction to launch the shells. By the way, to help with distance calculation, a new PDA module called "Navigation" has been added to the game. This module adds a new functionality to your PDA—a ruler. With it, you can measure the required distance and determine the azimuth, then simply aim the mortar in the right direction. This module can be purchased from faction traders in the "Foothills" location or found in any of the world’s loot crates.

By the way, the mortar can launch shells up to a distance of 1 kilometer. Additionally, achievements have been added to the game for using the mortar.

[previewyoutube=23naH_SG-QI;full][/previewyoutube]

The maximum number of faction points for capturing has also changed: now, in battles within the "Foothills" location, faction fighters can earn up to 1,000 points. As before, these points are awarded for defeating the enemy, but there are additional ways to earn them. For example, when you capture a radio tower. If your faction gains control of the towers and starts earning the necessary points to win, all players in that faction will also receive a small amount of personal faction points passively.

The rewards for victory have also been updated. Considering that there is no longer a need for various equipment (like MRP and jammers), the rewards are sufficient to cover the costs of war for fighters, even if the loot is simply sold to traders. Of course, this depends on your personal contribution to the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/011e89278aca75c163d93e8421f3b0ef89ecb9dd.jpg[/img]

[quote]While working on the "Foothills" location, our team paid special attention to balancing the location design for PvP. We aimed to provide players with a new "PvP mode" with entirely different outpost capture rules, ensuring symmetry in tactical opportunities for both factions. We also tried to address all possible gameplay scenarios and eliminate issues like "respawn wars" while giving players the ability to quickly return to the battlefield after death or change their attack strategy, making the gameplay more intense and diverse.

Notably, characters left in the location outside of the outpost will be automatically sent back to the entry points by default. This solves the problem of so-called "logouts," where enemy fighters leave characters near bases.

There is also room for players who don't feel comfortable in direct firefights: they can control tactical transitions using drones to highlight enemies for their teammates or use mortars, thus contributing to their faction's efforts.

In version 0.58, we will continue to develop and improve the "Foothills" location based on feedback and constructive suggestions from our players.
[/quote]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

- On an experimental level, the character render distance in the "Foothills" location is set to 600 meters. If this render distance causes significant performance issues, we will adjust this value accordingly.

- Weapon repairs now take into account the number of modifications applied to the weapon. The parts required for modifications and their repair are hard to come by, making modified weapons valuable. Since rare parts are used in modifications, this makes weapon repairs more challenging and affects the cost of repairs.

- The recon drone now has the ability to drop F1, RGD-5, RGD-5M grenades, as well as gas and smoke grenades. To drop a grenade, the drone must be equipped with it before takeoff. Use the "Spacebar" to drop the grenade.

[previewyoutube=t2OmG5GL1VY;full][/previewyoutube]

- Additional key bindings for drone control have been added in the control settings—please check these settings.

- Scrambler, RideOrDie, and Nomad motorcycles can now perform quick turnarounds. Check the control settings under the "Vehicles" section.

[previewyoutube=q-7c6-Amb6c;full][/previewyoutube]

- Minor inaccuracies in the German localization have been fixed.

- Minor inaccuracies in the Chinese localization have been fixed.

- A bug with the outline display of airborne objects near anomalies has been fixed.

- A filter has been added for sorting Mail in the PDA. You can now view only new (unread) messages.

- Minor issues with bullet particles have been fixed.

- Minor design flaws in locations have been corrected.

- The paint masks of some factional body armor have been changed. Materials have been optimized.

- The visual recoil for most weapons has been improved.

[previewyoutube=F_Tn36AjmF4;full][/previewyoutube]

- The duration of good weather in the game has been increased.

- Optimization work has been carried out.

- Due to the introduction of new control keys, your control settings may be reset. Be sure to check your control settings after updating the game.

The update is now available for download. Update your game client!

Sincerely,  
Your WTL Team

notes.title: Update 0.58.2 - "Quench The Thirst with Gasoline"
notes.notes:
Fighters!

Today, with the release of update 0.58.2, the event "Quench The Thirst with Gasoline" begins! The formidable and fierce drone RW-01 once again poses a threat to the locals, and only brave squads of fighters will be ready to confront it, standing up [b]to protect the weak![/b]

[h1]Event "Quench The Thirst with Gasoline"[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/a29b6ec90e99a3d63e5b018644e5810826cc2360.jpg[/img]

As before, you will meet the Biker in many locations, a long-time friend of Grisha Mazyuta. The Biker is once again ready to share a set of biker clothing and motorcycles in exchange for chrome bolts. This time, you can trade with the Biker not only for the classic Scrambler but also for the black Ride or Die!

You can obtain bolts by completing quests, exploring boxes, and killing monsters, but you will get the most bolts by defeating the robot wolf RW-01.

The rewards for defeating the RW-01 drone now include simple biker vests: they do not have any logos or badges. These vests cannot be purchased in the store or traded with the Biker, but they can be placed in the account inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/2becfcb76ef795fe34b3176465b6045e4635a8e7.jpg[/img]

Classic vests can still be traded with the Biker, and new ones have appeared in the in-game store, appealing to those with a sense of humor.

But vests are not the only new addition to the in-game store. [b]The "Nomad" motorcycle [/b]is now available—a bike for true travelers and adventure seekers! Like the "Ride or Die," it comes in a set with gasoline.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/bba2684ebe15426c5ccf2a65cb4fcdde63c7fa14.jpg[/img]

The event starts with the release of the update and will last until July 14th, inclusive, in the UTC time zone. Afterward, the Biker will remain in the locations for some time to allow all players to exchange their bolts.

[h1]Change List[/h1]

Of course, in addition to the "Quench The Thirst with Gasoline" event, we have made several changes to the game:

- Improved the Scrambler model: the headlight is now glass and transparent.
- Added new PvP quests for clan development. Now, clans can be developed not only with chevrons but also through various PvP tasks.
- Points for capturing outposts are now awarded for defusing mines, destroying mines, and destroying equipment.
- Grenades can now trigger the detonation of enemy mines, thus clearing the battlefield.
- Reduced the penetrability of brick walls in buildings.
- Changed the "Dodgy" skill for the mercenary: now, with a certain chance, this skill allows the mercenary to survive critical damage (a "one-shot"), giving the mercenary a second chance.
- Large-caliber bullets (e.g., .338 or 12-gauge) can now knock characters off their feet when hit.
- Increased the overall armor-piercing capability of almost all .308 rounds, including M1 and S1. This will enhance the effectiveness of using the MSR-10 and MSR-12 in combat.
- Reduced the additional non-critical headshot damage multiplier. Critical damage and critical hit chances when hitting the head have not been changed.
- Fixed an issue with the incorrect positioning of collimator sights on the MP5.
- Fixed an issue with "Udav" pistols painted in "Tiger" paint. Everything now looks correct.
- Using CCD now has a 5-minute cooldown.
- The recon drone has received a targeting function.
- Players now have the option to refuse to respawn at MRP-1 if it is poorly placed, making them an easy target for the enemy. If you decline to respawn on MRP-1, characters will respawn at the last safe zone instead.
- We continued working on improving the particle effects of shots, casings, etc., so several weapons have received new visual effects when firing.
- Each breath-holding now depletes stamina.
- Fixed the shooting animation of the GSh-18 "Alpha".
- The description of armor now displays a complete list of supported armor plates. Previously, this list only showed the main types of plates.
- The healing effect of using multiple healing grenades no longer stacks.
- Fixed shortcomings and minor errors in the locations "Minaev's Territory," "Maze," "Eastern Territories," "Canyon," "Coast," and "Solnechny's Outskirts."
- Added a new dialogue in "Solnechny."
- Fixed minor issues with the quilted jacket model.
- Fixed an issue in the "Testing Grounds" location where some cover objects would "cut off" at a distance (disappear), allowing you to see and shoot at the enemy.
- Fixed an issue that caused the client to crash when transitioning between locations with a monocular in hands.

notes.title: Update 0.58.1
notes.notes:
Good day, fighters!

As You may know, after the release of update 0.57.17 our team has been focusing on the major update 0.58, which includes a huge number of changes, and will also introduce a new PvP-location "Foothills", work on which is still going very active. 

During this time we have made a huge number of changes to the game, so our plans for the near future are as follows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/5eed80c54bd2c3091bc17b93bc94b75720302a24.jpg[/img]

The development of the 0.58 branch starts with the 0.58.1 update, which brings a huge number of important changes that affect gameplay and balance. Since there are really a lot of changes, we are sure that first of all it is necessary to debug all these changes and make sure that everything works stably.

After that, we plan to release an update with the location "Foothills". This location will represent not only a new landscape for faction battles but also a new game mechanics of capturing roadblocks, which will be different from those mechanics that you have met before in our game - yes, yes, the capturing will take place in a new way. All these works are being done according to the plans we announced earlier, and at the moment we don't see any serious reasons for changes in the timeline - we expect the location to be released by the end of the second quarter of 2024.

Well, now it's time to check out the list of changes that start the branch 0.58 development. Let's go!

[h1]New game features[/h1]

- Added new equipment: target designator. Target designators can be placed in the 3rd and 4th slots of the character's equipment. When the corresponding key is pressed, all players in the group who are in the same location as the sender will get a target marker with a distance designation. Sending out the markers consumes battery power. Discharging depends on the number of group members who received the maker. The device requires faction and is available for purchase in the Big Village, Canyon, Testing Grounds, and Tunnels locations.
- The target designator markers are displayed in the group list, next to the character's name.
- Added new equipment: walkie-talkie. The walkie-talkie allows you to communicate by voice with players in a group with the walkie-talkie sound effect. It works also between locations and is available for purchase in the locations "Big Village", "Tunnels", "Canyon", "Coast" and "Testing Ground".
- Now, if your teammate in the group has been killed, you will see the marker of the place of his death on the screen. Thus you will understand where he was killed.
- Group markers and group member identification stick to the edges of the screen if they are not in the line of sight.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/5c2da8fe8c8c529f210f0afdde43136e97804f39.jpg[/img]
- New sandbags have been added to the game, which can be installed in the "Canyon" location and the upcoming "Foothills" location. The bags are installed and repaired with a shovel. Several players can take part in the repair and installation of bags. Since the installation of bags has been greatly simplified, it was decided that the bags do not need to be saved in the state of the location and they will be deleted after a server restart.  Also, these bags will self-destruct over time. You can buy them from merchants in the location "Canyon" and "Foothills".
- Players can now quickly get off a motorcycle. If done at speed, the character may take damage, but it is much faster than a full stop and get-off.
- Players can now use medical kits and healing stimulants while riding a motorcycle.
- Engineers now receive notifications of low battery and destruction of their equipment (MRP, MHP, and jammers).
- Now recon drones are created not by quest, but on rigs in the location “Testing Ground”. The quest “Faction Order” is required for production. Those players who have completed this quest before do not need to do it again.  Also, drone creation now does not require “Faction Arsenal 2”, but it does require clan level 5.
- The “self-destruct” mode of the Recon Drone has been replaced with the “kamikaze” mode. In this mode, the drone dives to the designated target at a higher speed, but without the ability to adjust the flight.
- Drone Power Module, Drone Navigation Module, and Drone CPU can now be put up for commission.
- Stationary machine guns have been improved: firing them now looks more interesting, and their scatter and increased damage allow for better suppression of the enemy.
- Stationary machine guns can now be reloaded through the inventory while in use.

[h1]Weapons and armor[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/2464be88ec41ea7d206f4e510eaed0cde938f495.jpg[/img]
- Added new level 35 pistol - “Udav” in 9x21 caliber. It has an excellent rate of fire, and magazine capacity, as well as a very good armor-piercing ability. This pistol will be useful in PVP as a short-range weapon. The ability to create 9x21 M1 ammo has been added to the recipes. The pistol and ammo, as well as the GSL-02 silencer, can be purchased from traders in the “Canyon” and “Testing Ground” locations. The in-game store has added “Udav” pistol painted into “snake-style” skin, because “Udav” means boa. The pistol is sold as a kit with a silencer and scope. This pistol will not be sold all the time and only for a limited time.
- The ballistics of the weapon has been redesigned. It became more similar to what players are used to seeing in other games: if a weapon is designed for close combat, it will be effective only in close distance, and if it is designed for long-range combat, it will be effective at long distances. Thus, the class of weapons in the game has become more pronounced. For example, now shooting from pistols or shotguns at 200-300 meters becomes ineffective: bullets fall fast enough, and lose their energy (and damage) depending on the distance.
- Breath holding is now more effective at stabilizing the aiming swing.
- Fixed an issue that caused firing damage to not decrease depending on distance.
- The spread of all weapons has become more comfortable for the game. Separately emphasize that the influence of recoil and frequency of single shots remained, but now it is more predictable.
- The armor penetration of such pistols as Glock 17, Springfield and GSh-18 has been increased.
- GSh-18 can now be fitted with Point-X sight and GSL-01 silencer.
- Slightly reduced the accuracy of 12 Caliber bullets.
- Now 12-gauge shots do not have an additional multiplier (bonus) to damage and armor-piercing in PVE, and also removed an additional multiplier for drone damage. The Miner class can handle PVE content well without additional help.
- Switching to the pistol from any other weapon is now 50% faster, so you can get the pistol faster than switching to another primary weapon.
- SL silencers now reduce damage by 15% instead of 20%.
- Silencers now almost always hide tracers. This has a positive effect on the stealth effect.
- Players can now always see their own tracers when firing through a scope (even if a silencer is used), to make it easier to correct their shooting, especially at long ranges.
- The maximum number of explosives in a location that can be set by an engineer is now 10 (total for MON-50 and “Burdock”).
- Fixed a bug that caused the total number of MON-50 mines and “Burdock” explosives installed in a location to be incorrectly displayed.
- Mines MON-50 and “Burdock” now have one common counter of the installed explosives on the location.
- Mines MON-50 and “Burdock” can now be dropped when a character dies.
- Shooting at MON-50 mines can now lead to the following results: the mine will explode, the mine will be destroyed without exploding, or nothing will happen. Thus, players now have a chance to clear the mine with a shot without exploding, but at the same time, the mine has a chance to survive an additional shot.
- M1 helmets of both factions are now medium armor class.
- Armor, especially heavy armor, now reduces a character's movement speed more severely.
- Quick grenade throw has been improved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/ad679170439f17a982c08a502161bb39ee39be9d.jpg[/img]
- The reticle of the KITE-2 sight has been redesigned. It is now more convenient to use this sight.
- The PO-1 reticle became identical to the PO-2 reticle.
- The PO-3 reticle has received additional divisions.
- Fixed a bug that caused the scope to swing harder than necessary at high FPS.
- Improved bullet hit particles on surfaces (ground, rocks, wood, metal).
- Now your aiming will not be “swing harder” as much if you get a hit while you are aiming.
- Axes and bats are now displayed behind the character's back if they are assigned to the first slot.

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
- Monster spawn is now always disabled during roadblocks capture on all PvP locations. All monsters that are out of the player's line of sight or far away from the players will die automatically at the time of the start of a roadblock capture. Those monsters that were visible to the players at the time of the start of the capturing or were in range will remain alive until the players themselves kill them.
- Added new animations of emotion: “Rock” and “Django”.
- Fixed a bug that caused graphics settings to be incorrectly applied (or reset).
- Invulnerability on revival on MRP is now no longer than 1 second.
- Fixed a bug that was causing glare to appear on collimators.
- The miner’s “Hustler” skill now works more correctly.
- Improved interface of the control settings menu.
- In the game settings, in the “Interface” section, a new option has been added: selecting simplified damage identification. Now you will be able to choose a “hit-marker” in the form of a crosshair or use the usual damage identification with damage information.
- FPS in the main menu is limited to 60 frames, and VSync is forced to be activated. This is to reduce resource consumption while the player is in the main menu. In general, we recommend using similar settings while playing the game.
- Optimization of some on-screen widgets has been performed.
- Improved the light in the weapon painting interface.
- Fixed an issue that caused the number of particles and sounds when hit with 12 Caliber shots to be many times greater in third-person than it actually should be. This could cause performance and stability issues when a lot of miners are gathered at an event.
- Fixed a stone in sector C6-3 in the location “Canyon”, in which it was possible to install equipment.
- Fixed design issues in the locations “Solnechniy Outskirts”, “Coast”, “Exclusion Zone” and “ The Big Village”.
- Improved lighting in tunnels with bandits in the location “Testing Ground”.
- Healing grenades can now drop when a character dies.
- Slightly revised the chances of dropping loot from phalanxes and drones.
- Arenas now have their own simplified character identification. 
- Added POSP scopes in paid coloring to the in-game store.
- Improved caching of game files. For users with sufficient RAM, we recommend using the “Use caching for game assets” option in the game settings.

Please update client of the game, 
Your WTLOnline Team

notes.title: Patch for update 0.57.9
notes.notes:
Fighters!!!
Today we've rolled out a small but important update, with changes to the "Canyon" location, as well as changes to the balance of events in the "Drone Arena" location.

Let's start with Canyon. The guide at the North Outpost now takes the side of the attacking faction, changing the safe zone accordingly. So, for example, if the Northern Outpost belongs to the Black Sunset faction, the safe zone of the guide will be for the Confederation faction and vice versa. Players of other factions (and without factions) will be unable to take this safe zone and dying will fall into sector A1 - the entrance to the location through the "Swamps". Similarly, the entry point in sector C6-5, known among players as "rags", has changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/f98d23f0e2d2ae3406c117b663906423a2a2d45f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/560f93d7f0b794d244bad3dfbbb51c9b1b933b07.png[/img]

As for the "Arena of the Drones" - we see that the number of players in the "Arena of the Drones" has increased. We believe that this is a positive result. However, at the same time, the increase in the number of players leads to the fact that the events in the "Arena of the Drones" have become quite simple: not all players have time to get the desired prizes and awards, as the life of drones is too fleeting. While some players don't have time to fight this or that drone, other players have enough free time to create discomfort for others. We decided to slightly increase the vitals of some drones to make them stronger. In the meantime, we found out that armor wear was not counting correctly for some types of drones as expected - this has also been fixed.

notes.notes:
Good day, fighters! Today we have prepared update 0.57.5, adding new quests, various improvements, and new objects. The mechanics of lock-picking doors and fishing have been reworked, various many minor errors and shortcomings have been fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/2cb48dd466034d9788fe84c7f80d1eb12b1109b7.jpg[/img]

[h1]The fire department at the "Minaev's Territories"
[/h1]

The new object has appeared not far away from Depot in the "Minaev's Territories" location  - the Fire Department.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/c98c1bb14c0ce3ce8148a37580085e2bf076b848.jpg[/img]

This area will be interesting to 7-10lvl players and contains several mini-quests. Also, players will be able to find a safe in this area with good rewards for these levels. Thus, the world of Will To Live Online becomes more filled.

[h1]Updated lockpick mechanics[/h1]

Lock-picking of the doors is now interactive and directly depends on your skills as a player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/10f99469f6bad17f050d5242c5b15345c909748d.jpg[/img]

Players have to find the correct sequence of the pins. As a reward for lock-picking (in addition to the items already available), the player who opens the lock will be able to get additional valuable loot in the stashes behind this door. Thus, by opening doors with lockpicks, players will receive more valuable loot than before. 
 
1) The difficulty of lock-picking is determined by the number of pins.
2) Attempts to press the pins (both successful and unsuccessful) can break lockpicks. A failed attempt has a higher chance to break the lockpick.
3) The corresponding Engineer skills will no longer increase the chance of lockpicking, but increase the chance of saving lockpicks.
4) Boxes behind closed doors (many, but not all) now realize they are hidden behind these doors. After opening the lock of the door for the character who performed this opening, it becomes possible to receive additional loot in one of the boxes that are behind this door. Moreover, the quantity and quality of loot are depend on the complexity of the castle, and the “bonus” itself is valid only once after the fact of opening. Then the more difficult the hacked door lock, the better the reward.
5) In the "Canyon" location the doors at the outposts are closed with 4 pins locks - they are easy enough to crack (approximately 7-15 seconds). We didn't make these doors difficult to open, as players use closed doors as a tactical element.

Use the WSAD keys and the spacebar to control lock picking.

[h1]The "Dead Forest" location[/h1]

The color correction of the "Dead Forest' location has been made. Now, this location looks even more atmospheric at any time of the day and in any weather at the maximum settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/308e4303b515a09f45be366c9fb546b760460900.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/bff47cb8be5330d1b19f2c78d9e77552b36bb217.jpg[/img]

[h1]New fishing mechanic[/h1]

Players can no longer search for letters on the keyboard while fishing. While fishing, you need to hold the fish so that it does not fall off the line and gently pull it out when it gets tired of resisting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/df61799d78dd40eeaf46fd94c2843ba46e2961cd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] A new recipe has been added: Melted Bear Fat.
[*] Added a new recipe: Fried  Heart of the Hog of the Coast.
[*] Removed all debuffs from fried Crab Heart.
[*] Added new in-game achievements.
[*] Fixed incorrect inscription on the Kite-2 scope.
[*] Added new quests in the "Tunnels" and in the "Forestry" locations.
[*] Removed the ability to install MHP and MRP inside trucks at the Canyon location.
[*] The problem with some boxes that could not be inspected has been fixed at the "Coast" location
[*] The problem with some boxes that could not be inspected has been fixed at the “Minaev’s Territory” location.
[*] Silencer skins have been added to the in-game store.
[*] Fixed a problem with the “Radio” anomaly in the “Forestry” location in sector D2-1.
[*] The quest “Bear Meat” in the “Swamp” location now displays the quest point on the mini-map when completing the quest.
[*] Fixed a problem with the localization of notes from the “Exclusion Zone” location.
[*] The problem with excessive darkening in some places of the "Minaev's Territory"  location has been fixed.
[*] Hacking the command core at roadblocks will be slightly more difficult (in all locations).
[*] New random music can now play as ambient in locations
[*] AMD FSR technology has been updated to version 2.1.2.
[*] Game settings are divided into categories combined by meaning.
[/list]

notes.title: Description of update 0.57.4
notes.notes:
Good day, fighters!

Well, the smuggler sold all the honestly stolen goods and went off in an unknown direction to get drunk about the lost excess profits. Frost Deer, characteristically, went after him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/7ca98e0515c77d0574aef93622b87744f60cda9f.jpg[/img]

Traders from the Canyon, Testing Grounds, and Coast have expanded their assortment: they have received a batch of silencers that will fit all the most powerful weapons. Silencers are an interesting thing. They allow you to fight stealthily: the target that catches the bullet will not see the damage identifier, and where this bullet actually comes from. But there is a price to pay for stealth. Silencers increase accuracy, but reduce damage - this is indicated in the description of both the silencers themselves and in the weapon description after they are installed. Moreover, silencers reduce damage not from the base value, but from the final one. Therefore, here some players may have misunderstandings, but everything is smooth there.

In the Tunnels location, Alyosha, wearing very high-quality branded music headphones, has new tasks that open a line of nine quests. Also, seven mini-quests appeared in the Exclusion Zone location. Objects in the Testing Grounds and Coast locations have been optimized. We also fixed issues with the crabs from the "Coast", now they spawn correctly.

notes.notes:
Fighters!

The "Quench the thirst with gasoline" event has already begun, and with it, update 0.57 is available for download! In this update, you will face a powerful new boss that can be encountered in several locations at the same time during the event! Also, we've made a large number of changes and improvements, and added new quests and objects in locations!

[h1]The "Quench the thirst with gasoline" event [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/1ecad3dbfe66b8b3dd7422bb9bc6f9f4f2cdd00c.png[/img]

A new NPC has appeared in the locations - Biker. He is an old friend of Grisha "Mazuta". Like Grisha, he loves motorcycles. But if Grisha is “for practicality”, then his friend prefers beauty and aesthetics. Therefore, he has valuable goods for the locals: a new stylish motorcycle and new bikers' equipment. You can get them if you bring what he needs - chrome bolts.

Along with the new NPC, a new threat has appeared in the locations "Coast", "Korovie", "Eastern Territories" and "Swamps": the cybernetic wolf (drone). [b]You can only meet it at night.[/b] This drone is an experimental development by WSC that was not completed on time. In particular, the system for determining the threat and targets was not correctly configured. Due to a misconfiguration, this drone destroys living targets within range and also uses the ability to call for backup.

Depending on the battle stage, the cybernetic wolf calls other drones to help him and opens up new attacks. We also tried to adjust the mechanics of the event in such a way as to maximize the usability of all the strengths of the character classes. Thus, for example, damage to the main character of the event will be dealt with at a greater distance, and characters of the "Hunter" class will be able to deal more damage to flying targets and other assistants. In addition, all the goals that participate in the event are counted when issuing a reward for completing the event, and the process of issuing a reward works even for those characters who are not currently in the event zone but took an active part in it.

By defeating the cybernetic wolf, you will be able to get the most precious chrome bolts, which can be exchanged for event items. However, chrome bolts can also be obtained in another way: by completing quests, searching crates, and so on.

[h1]Event Rewards[/h1]

After collecting the required number of bolts, you can get a new transport - Scrambler. It is significantly faster than a moped and also has better handling. Its tank holds more gasoline, however, and its fuel consumption is higher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/9e84294d6851090afb7b5b45188c1867b23f30f7.png[/img]

You can also get a set of biker clothes - a helmet, vest, and jeans. The vest is presented in four colors to choose from and has a feature: it hides a backpack on the back so as not to spoil the look of a stylish biker. This set has no faction requirements and is universal for all types of players and classes, as it belongs to the category of light armor, like chitin armor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/865957fe80f0d27a2b2337ea282dff3c95c9ee82.png[/img]

Also, for those who do not have the time, opportunity, and desire to search for chrome bolts, a scrambler and a set of clothes can be purchased in the in-game store.

The event will last from August 17 to September 4 23:59 UTC. After the event ends, the wolf drone and chrome bolts will be removed from the game. The biker will stay for a while, so players can exchange the received bolts for prizes.

[h1]Location design improvements and new quests[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/be8dc3db3d39c8584c3950cc108821bad44e6d53.jpg[/img]

In this version, we've added 12 new quests in the Korovie location, some of which can be obtained from NPCs, and some of which become available on the bulletin board as these quests are completed. Also in the location "Korovie" appeared additional objects in the direction of the abandoned laboratory. As the quests are completed, players will have access to a new way to get fuel, as well as quite a good amount of experience, which will positively affect the leveling-up of characters up to level 20.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/6b45abe3d354b1a84f5ede7f391b118a98c28f9a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/17559c048d6a7233ba5197f47d99c16793018155.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]

- Ratburger and perfect broth no longer drop out of inventory on death
- Now, if the body armor has hand protection, then when it hits the hands, armor plates are no longer used for protection, only armor, and its characteristics. Armor plates, respectively, are not destroyed when shot into the hands
- Now the description of body armor indicates the presence or absence of hand protection
- The shooting system has been significantly redesigned. We expect that now the weapon will be more responsive, and various problems and situations when the weapon stopped shooting for some reason should be fixed (in the absence of other problems, for example, with the Internet on the user's computer). Along with this, various small conveniences in the behavior of weapons were added. For example, a weapon will fire immediately after reloading if the fire button is held down while reloading the weapon. Also in the game settings, an option for automatic reloading has been added. By default, auto-reload is disabled.
- Added new mobs: Black jelly
- In the "Canyon" location, new objects have been added at the entrance to the "Testing Grounds" location. Players returning from the "Testing Grounds" to the Canyon can now use these hideouts
- Reworked indoor lighting for such NPCs as Gosha, Senya and Victoria
- Fixed many bugs in the design of locations
- Added new objects in the location "Solnechny Outskirts"
- Improved behavior of drones like Goliath
- A lot of work has been done on the quality of the game code. This is not always noticeable to the players, but we have tried to improve the vast majority of algorithms in the game as much as possible, which should positively affect the performance and stability of the game.
- Improved vehicle handling. In addition to improvements made for the new motorcycle, the moped has also been improved.
- Improved support for game controllers when driving a motorcycle. In general, control with the controller allows you to control the motorcycle more accurately.
  - Several new achievements have been added to the game, including those related to the event.

notes.title: Update 0.56.8
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/a855cb724e20705064032c884c4d90c732ba3cac.png[/img]

In this version, the “Testing Ground” location got the following changes in the economy:

[list]
[*] The new valuable loot has been added to jellies that live in this location.
[*] Faction merchants, that placed at faction entrance to the location, from now can buy loot from jellies and drones.
[/list]

Thus, a faction that didn’t manage to capture territories in the “Testing Ground” location got an opportunity to farm valuable loot and earn tokens, even this faction doesn’t own any territories. It brings a possibility to prepare for the next battle to the “losing side”.

Together with that, due to the excess of parts of the sun spider on market and the increased demand for the drone’s parts, the basic price of sun spiders’ parts has been reduced by 10% (it affects all merchants in the game).

[h1]The “Coast” location[/h1]

In the “Coast” location, a new four quest has been added, which targeted on 35+ level players. For completing the entire questline, players will ultimately receive a good amount of experience. Also, the hogs of the coast have a new loot - the "heart of the hog of the coast".

[previewyoutube=6u9XA3_swJ8;full][/previewyoutube]

If for some reason you do not like this effect, you can always turn it off in the game settings - a corresponding option has been added.

This function allows systems with a good amount of RAM (16GB+) to get more smoothly gameplay by pre-caching the used game data (instead of the usual mechanism for loading data as it is used). In theory, this should reduce the "lags" during the first appearance of some objects in the game (characters, monsters, etc.). This increases memory consumption and slightly increases the time to enter the game.
As a reminder, this feature is experimental and intended solely for systems with a lot of RAM.

Hello, fighters!

Today we have released update 0.56.1, which adds new opportunities for creating modified weapons, mopeds became available, new quests were added, the contents of the airdrop were changed and many different improvements were made!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/b6ac4c19658ba5c30fbd46fcb6a33ed5f4e99707.png[/img]

[h1]Mopeds[/h1]

Fighters! If you have completed Grisha's questline, then in this version you got a possibility to purchase a moped from him! It will be possible to use a moped from level 13, and the cost of this vehicle is 200,000 tokens. The moped requires refined gasoline, which will need to be produced from low-quality fuel by distilling it at a chemical station. By the way, fuel consumption depends on the weight of the items in the inventory. To use the moped, completing the questline isn't required, but a recipe for the production of refined fuel is needed. Recipe can be obtained for quests or can be bought from an NPC.

For those who do not want to spend the time completing quests, there is a possibility to buy a moped in the in-game store, and in special colors, including the symbols of factions. [b]Please note that mopeds with factional colors have factional affiliation![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/26bd2e466b49d8be37f8f2974016c41b74c5a976.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/7cf72fcfb573dd01d3d6c9f6dfddda9155b4a148.png[/img]

It is also worth noting that vehicles usage is not allowed in all locations. For example, in safe zones, underground locations, or in the Exclusion Zone, it will not be possible to ride a moped.

[h1]Modification kits[/h1]

Thanks to the modification kits, you can apply modifications to the created weapons in the "Testing Grounds" location, as well as to Lucky, Fortune weapons, and weapons in a paid skins. The kits are divided into 5 main types:
[list]
[*] pistols
[*] submachine guns
[*] shotguns
[*] assault rifles
[*] rifles
[/list]

Each type of modifier set has three subtypes:
[list]
[*] damage modifier
[*] accuracy modifier
[*] wear modifier
[/list]

Each attempt to apply a modification will reduce the success rate for the next modification. And if the modification is unsuccessful, then it will not be applied, and the weapon will be broken. Weapons that already have modifications have a lower chance of enchanting success. The probability of success for the modification will be displayed in the game interface. You will not be able to “reset” applied modifications.

To create a modification set, you need to find a blueprint and all the parts needed for it. Spare parts can be obtained by disassembling weapons you do not need, which you can find, for example, from NPC bandits. Blueprints can be obtained by participating in various events around the world of the game, as well as by ransacking airdrops.

[h1]Quests and new devices[/h1]

New quests have been added to the locations "Tunnels", "Coast" and "Swamp". After completing the questline in the "Tunnels" you can get a new device - i-SAAC. It is similar to the i-HR and allows you to repair MRP and MHP "on the fly" - you just need to direct the i-SAAC to the installed MRP or MHP to start the repair. The i-SAAC device can only be used by an engineer, although characters of any class can complete the quest for it.

Another new device available to all classes is the Demining Grenade. It forces all mines to be detonated within a certain radius. Also, it can be thrown into the “Radio” anomaly, and it will cause detonation of all mines on the other side of the teleporter.

Fishing lovers are in luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/d345fd258421d2bff6081e37d6ff4c6d080d5098.png[/img]

While fishing in the "Coast" location, you can get small and relatively simple quests, but with a good reward!

[h1]Airdrop[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/6b6c193c766c93c0de22a09549d2cee78a4f77ea.png[/img]

In this version, we have changed the set of available airdrops loot. The "Izolenta" series weapon has been removed, and the "Lizzard" and "Chameleon" have been added instead. Algorithms for calculating the chance of skins drop were changed: we think that we will not hear from you more complaints about the fact that “there are too many skins in the game, which reduces their value”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/28589b264cbace78dfe183dbf6e55e8abd1a1297.png[/img]

Also, a set of Hi-Tech armor was added, which is in many ways similar in characteristics to the chitin set of armor, but still has some differences in level requirements and characteristics. For example, a bulletproof vest covers the arms and has the ability to install titanium plates.

[h1]Other changes[/h1]

- Improved animation of lizards;
- Demining and healing grenades can now be used in a safe zone;
- The energy of equipment that is placed in the account inventory saves correctly now;
- It is now forbidden to eat and drink if the character is not hungry and thirsty;

- Fixed an issue when merchants not buying weapons created in the "Testing Grounds" location;

- Fixed an issue that caused symbionts-shockers to become "white" at a long distance;
- Fixed an issue that prevented fire spiders from dealing damage to characters on close distances.

notes.notes:
Good day, fighters!
 
Today we've published update 0.55.6, which includes the "Lunar New Year" event, many in-game achievements and improvements have been added. Oh yes, [b]we also added an RPG-7.[/b] 

[h2]The "Lunar New Year"[/h2]
A mysterious old man in a white robe appeared in the settlements. He said that if you appease the spirits of the elements, you can get not only their favor and protection but also rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/b8623f41c7aea9abc9aff20706df2b144cffd8f6.png[/img]

Complete this old man's quests to appease the five Elemental Spirits and get themed weapon skins. All quests can be completed only once. Also, you will receive holiday snacks as a reward when you complete any quests in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/c7c22b9f0b882329a2d9b92cbddec888caf64cb7.png[/img]

The event will run from February 11 to February 17 inclusive. The NPC will stay in the locations for a while so that everyone can complete the quests. All items needed to complete the old man's tasks will be removed from the game at the end of the event. 

[h2]"Premium stash"[/h2]
 Now the owners of a subscription to "Premium Status" can place a special "premium stash" in the location. This stash can be used only by the character who placed it and only with an active "premium status". In other words, no one else will ever be able to ransack this stash, not even other characters in your account and characters from your group. The "Premium Stash" holds extra 50 kilograms in weight and has 5 more slots than a regular stash.
 
Note that if your "premium status" has expired, then you will not be able to pick up items from such stash: you need to activate the "premium status". 

[h2]RPG-7[/h2]

Ultimate, powerful and expensive! It has two types of charges: fragmentation and shaped charge. A fragmentation charge works simply: it hits targets with shards within a certain radius (more powerful than grenades).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/813ff41ea68113c2c8c3622cd33423f490a9e941.png[/img]

Shaped charge acts differently. It penetrates buildings, structures, and even stones and it is capable of hitting targets not only in the explosion zone but also inside shelters, as in the illustration below. The main advantage of this projectile is precisely that it is capable of destroying targets (enemy manpower, equipment, etc.) inside buildings and behind shelters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/68ec6bf97b33d54b3fdc8124e946e9d3bcd9802e.png[/img]

The weapon and the projectiles for it require the clan to have opened "Faction Arsenal" technology. 

[h2]In-game achievements[/h2]
 
We continue to develop in-game achievements and this time we have added 83 new achievements. Thus, the total number of achievements at the moment is 155, of which 46 are hidden. We plan to further develop our own system of achievements and we do not use achievements on Steam since this version. They will be removed from Steam in the near future (those players who already have achievements on Steam will have them, but we are not sure).
 
[h2]Other changes:[/h2]
 
- Improved the work of the monocular (now it correctly identifies monsters, and also learned to identify enemy NPCs). Also, the monocular received a night mode;
- Replaced some sounds of the environment in the "Canyon" location (including those that caused problems for streamers);
- Visually improved and optimized explosion particles;
- Dance animations now play cyclically;
- Fixed a bug that allowed to install of "MRP" and "MHP" inside large stones;
- Improved behavior of a huge cave spider;
- Reduced the cost of G43.300 shells for the grenade launcher (fireworks);
- In-game merchants now have Fireworks for sale, which can only be launched at night;
- The reticle now scales correctly when using low resolutions, as well as resolutions in 4: 3 format; 
- Many quest dialogs now display the quest reward before the quest is accepted. 

The servers were stopped for the update, please update the client of the game.
