notes.title: Update 0.54.6 [hotfix]
Update 0.54.6 has been released!
notes.notes:
Hello, fighters!

Today we’ve prepared for you update 0.54.6 in which we significantly reworked skill trees of each class, added new achievements and made different improvements and bugfixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/d8161d090f288b8da98f418657cf7d51f5e112a7.jpg[/img]

[h1]New skills[/h1]

Each class in the game has got a number of new skills, which, depending on the direction, affect your character.

In total, it was reworked and added:

- 25 common skills;
- 34 class skills to engineer and 27 class skills to other classes.

Since the number of skills has been increased, now players will receive 1 skill point per level.

For all classes, two mutually exclusive directions of development in skills are proposed, except for the engineer: he will have two mutually exclusive class directions and one additional.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/4105a1005edbd927d0404cd11ee8ddc4c2928f2a.jpg[/img]

The PDA interface has been redesigned, and in the “Skills” section there are now three tabs: “General Skills”, “Class Skills” and “Character Parameters”.

In the “Character Settings” tab, you can see the final influence of skills on the characteristics of your characters:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/e7caea48ae446e7c0a644f004bc41ed3ba70209e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Features[/h1]

[b]Mercenaries[/b] got “branches” with the names “Marauder” and “Stormtrooper”. In general terms, the Marauder branch is focused on “robbing” other players and saving their own loot,  and avoiding critical damage, while the “Stormtrooper”  branch is focused on endurance, critical damage, and weapon handling speed. Both directions share common skills for using assault rifles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/52192b8802c56d4dc85121a1e7ace89e5c8595e7.jpg[/img]

[b]Miners[/b] also got two directions: “Miner” and “Big Guy”. The “Miner” is focused on increasing the number of extracted resources and on the carry weight, but at the same time, it has a special skill “Bonebreaker”, which with some chance can cause the effect of a “broken leg” to your opponents in PvP. The "Big Guy" direction is aimed at resisting damage, increasing health and increasing damage from grenade launchers. Both directions share common shotgun skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/eeb2fc53a816544ff8935e809a06fc109779eccd.jpg[/img]

[b]Hunters[/b] got directions “Hunter” and “Sniper”. Skills from the Sniper branch are focused on PvP improvements and healing effectiveness. While the “Hunter” branch is focused on increasing damage in PvE, on environmental resistance, increasing the amount of loot and carry weight. A distinctive feature of the “Hunter” branch is that instead of increasing the chances of causing critical hit in PvP, “Hunters” got a chance to cause the effect of serious bleeding when they hit other characters. Both directions have common skills in using rifles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/fe2e7d6518ef9b5cb90b8605b1628ad2cde81a5d.jpg[/img]

[b]Engineers[/b] got the directions “Combat engineer”, “Bioengineer” and “Craftsman”.

[i]“Combat engineer”[/i] is aimed at enhancing the damage of engineers in PvP, including explosives, and amount of experience gaining when using items (weapons, medicine, etc.).

[i]“Bioengineer” [/i]is focused on improving PvE damage, increasing experience for killing monsters, increasing health, and healing efficiency. Both directions have common skills for submachine guns.

[i]“Craftsman”[/i] aims to reduce the speed of production and expansion of crafting queue slots. Also in this thread, there is a special skill that increases the chance of opening the door with lockpicks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/a5815a41df25fbdffacbe76cf6d51590daed1f39.jpg[/img]

[h1]Reset of the skills[/h1]

We've made a reset of skills for all characters with version 0.54.6. Note that skill redistribution is now paid for with tokens.

For some time, we will independently reset all skills for all characters. This should let you test various options for the development of your character and choose the most suitable for you. [b]Therefore, do not rush to spend your tokens to reset skills.[/b]

We've scheduled reset of the skills on Fridays after restarting of the servers:

- April 17th
- April 24th

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 21 new achievements;
[*] Changed reload animation of MSR-10;
[*] The event with the large flesh-eater has been redesigned: it became harder and more fun;
[*] Fixed a problem with the “Pay respect” animation;
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause disappearing of ammo on weapon reloading or switching ammo types;
[*] Increased the sound spreading distance of the shots for the Thunder and L96A1 rifles;
[*] During bad weather (rain, heavy rain, sandstorm) - the distance for rendering character identification is reduced;
[*] Changed animation of grass;
[*] Added a reminder that you need to assign the role to the player when accepting him into a clan;
[*] Improved visual particles for some anomalies;
[*] Server-side optimizations
[/list]

Good day, fighters!

Today we’ve launched an update 0.54.5 with the following changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/1b253d04965c6d624268b1692cd140c62bfb17af.jpg[/img]

[h2]Energy Shields[/h2]

Energy shields are the new tactical tool that can be useful in the fight. Shield blocks damage from both sides (inside and outside), but it is possible to move through it. This device is available for each class in the game. The shield can be destroyed by shooting or grenades explosion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/86fcbadca7f792d5639c07b6e86001d4c8927db8.jpg[/img]

EMI-grenades are an effective tool for destabilizing and disabling enemy electronics, such as an energy shield, jammer, MHP-1, and MRP-1.

At the moment, we have duplicated some of the achievements from Steam, and also added some new achievements. In the future, we will improve and extend the list of available achievements.

A list of achievements is available in PDA. Please note that achievements are issued to your account, not to the character. Since in-game achievements are independent of Steam, similar achievements will not be automatically credited. They will need to be completed again!

[*] NPC Alexei in the tunnels has a new story that he will gladly tell you. To believe in it or not is up to you.

notes.notes:
Good day, fighters!

Today we’ve released the big update with version 0.54.1, in which we did a lot of changes in the game. So, first things first!

[h2]Unlinked weapons to classes[/h2]

In this version, we’ve removed the weapon link to the classes. This is due to the fact that there is already some unlinked weapon in the game, and upcoming changes in the skill trees will be targeted to underline class roles stronger.

As you know, each class obtains its “inborn” bonuses for weapon usage of its own class, which additional increases thanks to skill-tree. And we are working on the reworking of skill-trees for each class now, which additionally increases the efficiency of using class weapons.

[b]In other words, yes, each character class now can use any weapon, but will it also be effective? [/b]Also, in the weapon's description will be pointed, is it fit your class or not.
In situations, when you use the weapon of other classes, will be applied a negative effect to the damage, accuracy, the chance of critical hit will be reduced, and the development progress of this weapon skill will be fined two times. More specifically, let’s suppose that you reached full weapon skills for assault rifles when you were a mercenary (100%). After, you decided to change your class to the hunter. In this case, when you become a hunter, assault rifles weapon skills will be fined by 50%. When you change your class back to the mercenary, the fine will be removed and your assault rifle weapon skill will be equal 100% again. In other words, going this way, we exclude universal “terminators” from the game, which will obtain full weapon skills for all weapon types.

[b]It should be noticed[/b], that if you use the weapon of your class, you obtain extra damage, full possibility to develop the class weapon and skills that work for your weapon. Thus, the efficiency of the usage of your class weapon increases high.
 
[i]Weapon class unlinking doesn't affect mines and equipment.[/i]

[h2]A new high-level weapon[/h2]

With update 0.54.1 each character class got a new high-level weapon.

[b]MSR-10[/b] – is originally semi-automatic carbine but thanks to modification, now it supports automatic fire mode for “Mercenary” class. It uses .308 Win caliber and based on AR-10. It obtains a magazine with capacity for 20 rounds, good accuracy, efficiency and available from 35th levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/def9d131de8d071ebe7ef1b48cde9391c2628f47.png[/img]

The new rifle for the “Hunter” class – [b]L96A1[/b]. This sniper rifle uses .338 Lapua Magnum rounds, box magazine with capacity for 5 rounds, and obtains muzzle brake from the box. Moreover, we have prepared a special optical sight for this rifle with 16x zoom – PO-3, but you can use and other sights, depending on your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/570ec94b6ee18abdacee32aec931d911a4a78cc0.png[/img]

[b]WSC PDW[/b] – is a modified version of KAC PDW, which uses 5.56x45 rounds instead of 6x35, unlike the original version. This automatic weapon very close by its dimensions to submachine guns, but at the same time, it has a very good stopping effect as automatic rifles. In addition, thanks to modifications by WSC, now in storehouses there is no need to store another type of ammunition. A nice choice for Engineers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/a1dbb021584879850b10fc5b0e1e6f90eb43366d.png[/img]

[b]Vepr 12[/b] is a new weapon for the “Miner” class, which will be available from the 35th level. Vepr 12 will obtain drum magazine with capacity for 20 cartridges, and support of automatic fire mode allows to provide dense firepower in battles at close range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/5bb013b2671415313a257f3c141d83c427247189.png[/img]

[i]New weapons are available on sale at the Canyon Outposts.[/i]

[h2]A new level cap[/h2]
Version 0.54 got an increased level cap. Now you can develop your characters up to 37th level including. In the future, during the development of branch 0.54, the level cap will be additionally extended with a new content update.

[h2]New armor[/h2]

In this version, we’ve added new faction equipment, which available to faction players from 36 levels. Same as weapons, the new equipment is only available at Outposts in the “Canyon” location. “Faction Arsenal” technology of clan also required.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/1e60cd3cb02f31ca296f01953e7d45a76c328334.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/dda8e2ff0640fec0d64348e5b25e747bc9795e74.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/8312beb73caf372333525d659c2851a5516b2ef0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/04bf7378e4a385e2abe8c979e698db44668d733c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/7a5ff2460a03d60acb4723d3472ff663f229ff81.jpg[/img]

[h2]New tools[/h2]

I-HR – Impulse Health Regenerator developed by WSC Company and based on NDP-technologies. This is a new tool for engineers, which thankful directed rays of concentrated NDP energy allow Engineer to heal your teammates on close distance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/acbf5a572cef833decc2492aa42d86a4aac79112.jpg[/img]


[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new quests for crafting i-HR;
[*] Added a new ITHAKI37 shotgun as an alternative to the MP-133;
[*] Armor plates now don’t influence to hands damage when it installed to armor which covers hands;
[*] 5.56x45 ammo has been added;
[*] [b]Like Hunters, Engineers can wear middle faction armor now;[/b]
[*] Specifications of 7.64x54M1 rounds have been improved;
[*] [b]Maximum carry weight now increases up to 30th levels;[/b]
[*] The chance of a drop of the components which required for ammo crafting has been reduced;
[*] Added new spawn points of Fire spiders in the Dead Forest location;
[*] Added new middle weapon and clothes repair kits;
[*] Players with disabled PvP now can’t ruin gameplay of other players anymore by body blocking of exits;
[*] [b]Some part of the hidden faction points that are awarded for Outpost capturing now converts automatically to the PvP-points of your clan.[/b] It should help develop your clan faster;
[*] Faction armor, which requires “Faction Arsenal” technology, now can be bought only by leader of clan or deputy; 
[*] We’ve started to work on sound engine improvements. Now the sound of explosions accounts for the distance and plays according to appropriate delay. In the future, we are going to implement such mechanics to other sounds in the game;
[*] Shotgun sounds have been improved;
[*] Added a description 
[*] Added a description of the effect of hunger and thirst on a character’s state;
[*] Gas grenades no longer cause poisoning effects on characters with PVP disabled, but only if they are below level 16.
[/list]

Hello, fighters!

We’ve launched a New Year update today! And, while the servers are on updating, welcome to read this patch note!

[h1]New Year Events[/h1]

A new NPC has appeared in key locations - Smuggler! He got somehow some Christmas stuff and he is not interested in money. He is interested in gift cards, that can be exchanged to the next items:

Mandarins: very effectively quench thirst and even hunger;
Lollipops: An excellent New Year's stimulator and even medicine for all occasions in life.
Champagne: not a bad festive drink, which is more effective than cider and slightly intoxicating;
New Year hat: Despite the festive appearance, it protects your head quite well.

All items that you receive from Smuggler [b]will stay with[/b] you even after the holiday event (excluding gift cards). You can do quests, kill monsters, explore some boxes to get gift cards. Cards will drop until 10/01/2020 00:00 UTC.

[h1]New Year Bundles[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/a3051412c739470e63ab0cdb5488368a1b92f320.png[/img]

Exclusive New year bundles added to the in-game shop, which available only until the holiday event ends. 

In total, four kits are presented:
[list]
[*] A small New Year Kit;
[*] Medium New Year Kit;
[*] Silver New Year Kit;
[*] Gold New Year Kit.
[/list]
 
Depends on the kit, you can get not only festive items but some exclusive stuff like Christmass bandana with Santa’s bread and S&W 500 with unique skins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/a82569c32938e59a48d27978cf0a2e52dabaad83.jpg[/img]

After the end of the New Year holidays, these kits will disappear from sale.
[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Drop from NPC now can be looted only by players, who hit NPC;
[*] The maximum number of mines that one character can plant in a location is limited by 30.
[*] 12Ga M1 Shot and Slug got increased PvE damage;
[*] PvE damage and armor-piercing now displays in the weapon specifications;
[*] PvE damage and armor-piercing now displays in the ammo specifications;

notes.notes:
Hello, fighters!

Today we’ve prepared the update 0.53.8. As we told before, we updated Unreal Engine to version 4.22, introduced a clan leveling system and many other things. 

[h1]Unreal Engine update to version 4.22[/h1]
Updating the game engine affects almost every file of the game, that’s why today’s patch is big.

However, thanks to this, experimental support for DirectX 12 appeared in our game. To run the game in the DX12 mode, you should configure Steam as on the screenshot below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/56fe7834db6f9b08d62e8f292043d4f8a3721d3f.png[/img]

If you get any issues with DirectX 12, we strongly recommend you to use DirectX11 mode.

[h1]Slot machines[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/de924f482627a4a69a6b1329df4485c6055ac2ee.jpg[/img]

Slot machines have appeared in the game. They are different by rates and prize pool. Some slot machines allow you to win not only money but custom weapon according to your class and medicine kits as well. 

[i]Let us note, that the win-rate chance of our slot machines is higher than on the same slot machines in real life.[/i]

[h1]Updated Clan System[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/35cecfdc4de9f7cf2dc12d36edb5542612a5e942.jpg[/img]

[b]Clan levels[/b]

Clans got their own leveling system. In other words, all new clans will obtain just first level and participants limitation which set up to 5 members. When clan gets a new level, the maximum quantity of participants increases to 5 members more. Moreover, each clan level allows open new technologies, which players have to study in the clan technology tree to make a clan stronger. 

It is useful to note that all clans, who already have a huge amount of participants, will not able to invite new members until they will not develop their clan to the required level.

[b]How to level-up the clan?[/b]

To increase the level of the clan, all participants should gain three kinds of points: PvE, PvP and Craft points. To earn these points, there are new daily quests will appear in the Clan interface of PDA. All these quests are sorted by a few types, and, depends on the quest, you receive PvP, PvE or Craft points. Wherein, all suggested quests will be possible to complete even by low-level players to make recruits useful as well for developing of the clan.

All of the gained points will account automatically to the general clan scores. 

[b]Clan skills[/b]

Clan skill trees appeared as well. Thankful new clan levels, new skills will available to study in the tree. Developing these skills let to get new possibilities for all participants of the clan. For example, you can study “Big clan storage” skills to increase the capacity of your clan storage, or, you can study “Faction Technologies” to get advanced technologies, recipes or ammunition of your faction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/d51c53bf59f97a6b1a806372e972e9f0a4651584.jpg[/img]

To study skills of the clan, participants of the clan have to earn “Technologies points” in the same way as PvP and PvE points. As in the first case, to get these points players must do clan daily quests. All received points accounts to clan score automatically as well, but the leader of the clan will decide which branch of tree better to study, and clan skills not possible to reset.

In general, we added about 30 daily quests that available in the clan interface of PDA.  Studied clan skills display in the special section “Clan Parameters”. At this moment, we added clan skill-tree designed for 5-6 levels, but we will increase the number of clan skills in the future.

[h1]New weapon[/h1]
In this version, we added two new revolvers: S&W .44 Magnum and S&W .500 Magnum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/62c8a3ebb93eb801fa635a3a8ab98f0af300a3f4.jpg[/img]

S&W .44 Magnum is targeted to 25th level players and looks pretty good on this level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30821281/6c5d03a94fd38334c9a157eb51705b6cdd68f0f2.jpg[/img]

S&W .500 Magnum is a first weapon in the game which targeted to 30th level players. It is a very powerful handgun that can make you wondered by eliminating enemies by one shot. Since .500 Magnum is a very strong caliber, this revolver requires 6 points of strength to use it.
Both revolvers are available at Canyon bases and from Karina in the Tunnels, however, ammunition for them is not on sale. Players should craft them.

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a possibility to create and edit the description of the clan;
[*] Solved a problem with railing collision in the tunnels;
[*] Mines and grenades now deal less damage through the walls;
[*] Guards were removed from Korovie. Now players must be more careful;
[*] Logs in the Clan storage now displays not a server time, but your local time;
[*] “Pioneer” rifle got reduced recoil;
[*] Fixed a bug with fast knife attack;
[*] Fixed several bugs with weapon switching;
[*] Fixed a bug due to the weapon was not able to switch after grenade throwing;
[*] Similar to 3D-preview, we added a possibility to preview any item before buying;
[*] Fixed a huge amount of small bugs.
[/list]

Changes of the shooting mechanics affect not only the PvP but for PvE too: monsters and NPC reacts on hit much faster, than it was before.

These improvements should be particularly apparent to players, who have an Internet connection with not enough stability and have a big ping.

[quote][b]Important:[/b] All hits account only within the drawing distance now.
попадания теперь фиксируются только в пределах дальности отрисовки.

Consuming of GPU resources by grass has been reduced by 20-30%. But not all of the players realize, that frame consists not only with grass. It may contain lots of other objects, such as terrain, skies, monsters, buildings, and characters. And each of these objects uses some power of GPU.

In general, these recipes might be found a similar way as the previous one  - by the natural way of exploring the world during the development of character. The crafting process includes a few steps, and each step requires its own recipe. For example, you have to find “Polymer Clothes” recipe, which you can get during killing big spiders in the “Spider Cave”. Also, you have to get a recipe for thermal treatment of spider shells, which can be found from NPC in Korovie. And finally, the final step,  recipes for chitin armor which you can get killing fire spiders.

In addition, there are some items appeared in the game, which might be bought from traders, such as salt, vinegar from food traders, and alkali from Senya in Korovie.

[h1]New quests[/h1]

In this version, we’ve added one interesting quest to Victor Petrovich in the Tunnels. This quest is available to all players who completed Herman’s task “Fix the generator” and allows players to upgrade their MRP-1 devices. MRP-1M has 400 meters radius, that two times more than regular MRP.

We’ve made a decision to return PvP-Arena in this patch with some remakes. Now PvP-arena available only for faction players and you can get into Arena only from Michalych and Valera accordingly. We made this decision because players in collusion with each other used PvP-experience to develop their characters faster.

[h1]English localization[/h1]

English localization has got major improvements in this update. Thanks to the community, English localization got a better quality of the translation. Thanks to everyone who has contributed to this. [h1]What is checkpoint?[/h1]

Checkpoint is the pass of the faction in Canyon.  In point of fact, each checkpoint will look like the faction base: there you will be able to find traders, warehouses and security staff in form of powerful, but mortal NPCs, own safe zone and respawn point. Checkpoints are located in strategically important places – near the places of resources extraction, which is in general important for economics and craft. 

As both factions in this territory are in active phase of combat operations, no interlopers are allowed to approach the checkpoint: everybody, who is out of faction controlling this checkpoint, will be shot by security staff. This includes players of no faction: it could happen that you spy in favor of enemy!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/315eae60b1878f87d1fe21e8fa390f3e36248f3b.jpg[/img]

[h1]How the checkpoint capture is going on?[/h1]

Engineers of both factions will get the special device, which will turn off the protective shield, but this requires time. Team capturing the checkpoint shall ensure the safety of this device. During the process of «crack» of checkpoint safety systems, you’ll have to fight with both players of alien faction, and aid in form of faction NPCs. These NPCs will be mortal, but heavily armed.
As soon as shield is off, players of faction controlling this checkpoint will lose an opportunity to respawn in this checkpoint. Therefore, to turn off the shield is half the battle. Further, you and your engineer shall reach the commanding center and reprogram the protection system for your faction. This requires some time as well.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/9ce425ed3ae9dcab3edc4d3068b024482a2b8046.jpg[/img]

[h1]What will players get for participation in capture?[/h1]

After the commanding center is reprogrammed, protective shield will appear around the checkpoint, which will act as the respawn point for your faction. Together with this, faction traders and warehouses will be available for you. As there are no other traders in this location, this is economical benefit.

[u][b]In future[/b][/u] (later), players will get definite amount of spare parts, which may be used in invention of different weapon modifiers. Modifiers of the following types are planned:

[list]
[*]damage modifier;
[*]precision modifier;
[*]wear modifier;
[*]weight modifier.
[/list]

You should keep in mind that each use of weapon modification decreases the chance of successful modification.

In such a way, having the control over the checkpoint, your faction and you as a player of this faction, get the following:

[list]
[*]Trade
[*]Warehouse
[*]Respawn point
[*]Conditional control over the territories of resources extraction 
[*]Participants earn the spare parts for weapon modifiers 
[*]Security service in form of faction NPCs
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/f7a5668d54ff4cddb9d0dd4d2dba836a0c2a3793.jpg[/img]

[h1]What will happen if alien faction gets the control over all the checkpoints? [/h1]

It is obvious that your faction loses, and Canyon territory comes under the conditional control of the enemy.

[h1]How often may the checkpoints be captured?[/h1]

For now we think that checkpoints may be captured not oftener than once in 24 hours. You may find the information on belonging of the checkpoint to faction and time left in the map in PDA. As well, you can define the belonging of the checkpoint to faction according to the flag over the checkpoint.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/ab5b5f0b62e4c4f1b6601668be3b943bc8668761.jpg[/img]

[h1]When the update with checkpoint capture will be published?[/h1]

As soon as it is ready. We expect to release this update till the end of November. At least, these are our plans.

notes.title: Description of update 0.51.2
notes.notes:
Today we’ve prepared the update 0.51.2, which brings the number of significant changes in game process.

[h1]PvE and PvP modes[/h1]

Starting from the update 0.51.2, ability to switch on the PvE\PvP mode on all servers will be available for all players.

[b]What for do we introduce these modes?[/b]

This decision was not easy for us, we have been thinking on it since April, monitoring the players and analyzing a great number of feedback. We reached the conclusion that at the moment this decision is the only correct solution of the issue. Reason for this decision is not hard to plumb: players of high level often disturb the newcomers in completion of quests and acquaintance with Will To Live Online world. As a result, players leave the game and do not come back. 

[b]How to switch PvP/PvE modes?[/b]

Switching of PvP/PvE modes will be available in your PDA. You can use this switch staying in safe zone only, and no more often than once in two hours. By default, on usual servers PvP mode is on, and on servers No-PK – PvE mode is on. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/5b49bbf288f599c2c0fd8579f74e0985ee8293e1.png[/img]

[b]How to understand that player is in PvP mode?[/b]

It is pretty easy to understand that player is in PvP mode – just watch his identification and find the skull sign. If you found it, player is in PvP mode. Moreover, we significantly quickened players identification in this update. Identification range also was increased by two times. This is made for your definition of player’s mode.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/59da74737e9db3ce20b63fb9d500dc48266d1b16.jpg[/img]

[b]How PvP/PvE mode influences neutral characters?[/b]

If your character is not in the faction yet, at active PvE mode you will not be able to kill other characters, and they will not be able to kill you.

[b]How PvP/PvE mode influences factions?[/b]

At active PvE mode you can always fight with characters from hostile faction only. Your faction mates and neutral players will not be able to deal you the damage, and you will not be able to deal damage to them. Arguably, this is an analogue of turned off FriendlyFire. At active PvP mode, you will be able to kill both your faction mates and hostile faction players, as it happened before. As well, in PvE mode you are not able to deal the damage to neutral players.

[b]Protection against players in PvE mode[/b]

Before introducing the ability to switch the PvP and PvE modes, we carried definite work for protection against those, who will misuse the PvE mode for his own ends.

[i]Time limit[/i] – switch the modes once in 2 hours only.
[i]Location limit[/i] – switch the modes in safe zones only.
[i]Protection against loot thievery[/i] – let us revise the details. To protect your loot against those who turned on the PvE mode, we developed the algorithm, which prohibits looting the monster for those who did not participate in its killing.

Character may look over the killed mob or NPC in the following cases only:

- if he dealt enough damage to monster;
- if he is in the group, which IN TOTAL dealt enough damage to monster;
- if he is in the clan, which IN TOTAL dealt enough damage to monster.

By so doing, those, who stood apart with active PvE mode, will not be able to search the monster killed by you, and your trophies will fall to you or your group mates or clan mates.

Besides, players in PvE mode will not be able to loot the corpses of players killed in PvP.

[i]Protection against bodyblock[/i]– bullets will pass through the players in PvE mode. This is done for the reason that players in PvE mode would not be able to act as human shield.

[b]Bonuses of PvP mode[/b]

As playing in PvP mode is much more dangerous that in PvE, players will get 5% more experience for killing monsters, other characters and NPCs. By so doing, upgrade of your character in PvP mode will happen much faster. As well, we increased the chance of drop after killing characters by 70% and drop amount by 20%.

[b]Conclusion for PvE/PvP modes[/b]

In whole and general, open PvP stays in game anyway, in spite of the mode you play. Stage of active PvP is just “moved” to later stage, when players have enough experience in the game and made the decision to enter the faction, and are able to take a stand for themselves. Therefore, players preferring PvP will have a chance to meet worthy adversaries, but at the moment when they are ready.

[h1]Ranks and faction points[/h1]

In update 0.51.2 players will be able to earn «faction points». Their quantity will influence your rank. Your current rank will be shown near the name of your character in its identification.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/8aa521f59575f908b5aeaa171e854aef30dba740.jpg[/img]

In «Faction» section of your PDA information on your current rank will appear, together with information on how many points do you need to earn for the following advancement.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/7e15ed166197c3aef91d0281fdfe653c1ca8ee2b.jpg[/img]

You will be able to earn the faction points for rank advancement in several ways. The first, the simpliest and the most natural way is the war with opposite faction and accomplishment of military missions of your faction. Killing the enemy you get definite number of points. The second way to earn the rank points is in accomplishment of faction quests in the course of their appearance in the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/3b2d1fbaa8befbade3021862d4e629030ae7d4a4.jpg[/img]

List of all the available ranks and required number of points may be checked by pressing the “Ranks table” button. As we know the agility of our game community, we would like to caution you against the mindless «getting» of ranks beforehand: we recommend you to wait for further game content that allows getting more rank points compared to normal faction PvP. However, if the war of factions is a normal game style for you, do not blind you down. Fight!

[b]Pay attention to the fact that if you kill your faction mates, you will loose your faction points and rank.[/b]

[h1]Level system of monsters[/h1]

In update 0.51.2 we changed the approach to the distribution of levels among monsters. Now all the monsters appear with minimal level, which is set in exact spawn. In due course, if monster is not damaged by players, or could fight the player for some reason, it increases its level and becomes stronger.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/d8b07b1e7ee0672ca6230a3c563f5f06ee94370f.jpg[/img]

Therefore, the longer monster lives, the higher is his level. The higher is monster’s level, the more loot and experience you will get.  Maximally possible level of monster is limited by settings of each separate spawn. Therefore, it will be more interesting for you to hunt more powerful monsters in virgin locations, and we, in our turn, will increase the number of spawns in locations.

[h1]New quests[/h1]

- New quests are added at Gosha’s place.
- New quests are added at Leshiy’s place.
- New quests are added at the Stockman’s place in «Korovie».
- Bulletin board added in «Korovie» with quests on it.

[h1]Balance update[/h1]

In update 0.51.2 we significantly revised the balance of many things in the game. Special attention was paid to the balance of bosses.

[b]Quests[/b]

- Experience for faction quests from the bulletin board was increased significantly.
- Leshiy’s quests in “Swamp” are now available starting from the Level 18.
- It became much easier to find mushrooms in Solnechny.

[b]Symbiont[/b]

- Experience for killing symbiont is increased three-fold.
- Additional experience of killing symbiont in group is increased.
- Loot amount at symbiont is increased.
- Symbiont’s respawn time was decreased.

[b]Big spider[/b]

- Now big spider doesn’t break character’s leg, if it didn’t throw him up. This modification shall positively influence the fight dynamics.

[b]Toxic spiders[/b]

[b]Armor[/b]

- Engineers and hunters now cannot wear medium faction armor of Level 27.
- Light faction armor of Level 27 is added for engineers and hunters.

[b]Miners[/b]

- Influence of heavy armor on the character’s motion speed is decreased. Now it will move faster.

[b]PvP[/b]

- Chance of drop after killing characters is increased by 70% and drop amount - by 20%.

[b]Shooting gallery[/b]

- Killing characters in shooting gallery doesn’t give experience now.
Locations
- In “Swamp” location NPC-robbers were added.
- Track to location «PvP-Arena» was removed. It’ll be back to game when Arena mode will be completed.

[b]NPC[/b]

- Behavior of hostile NPCs is improved. Now they periodically patrol the territory.

[b]Monsters[/b]

- Animation of several monsters’ death was improved.
- Killed jelly now can poison your character.

[b]User interface[/b]

- Icons in user interface are improved.
- Access panel now may be hidden automatically. Option is added in game settings, which allows switching on/off the automatic hiding of access panel.

[b]Localization[/b]

- English localization is improved. A thousand thanks to our English community for assistance and help!
- German localization is improved.

[b]Errors correcting[/b]

- Stashes do not block bullets any more.
- Errors in barter between player are fixed.
- Error, allowing opening doors without keys and picklocks is corrected.
- Ability to collect loot through the walls is corrected.
- Errors in locations design are corrected.
- Lots of small errors are corrected.
- Stability of servers operation was improved.

notes.title: Another part of information about update 0.51.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
Today we’ve prepared additional information about upcoming update 0.51.2. Let’s go!

[h1]Ranking and faction points[/h1]

Each player will be able to get Factional “points” in update 0.52.1. These points allow you to receive Rank of your faction. Your current rank will be shown near your nickname in the player’s identification.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/8aa521f59575f908b5aeaa171e854aef30dba740.jpg[/img]

You could find full information about your current rank in the “Faction” section of your PDA. Also, you will see, how many factional points you need to receive next rank.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/7e15ed166197c3aef91d0281fdfe653c1ca8ee2b.jpg[/img]

There are several ways to earn cherished points. The first, the easiest and most natural way is a war with the opposite faction and participating in combat missions of your faction. 

The second way you can gain the factional points is completing factional quests as they appear in the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/3b2d1fbaa8befbade3021862d4e629030ae7d4a4.jpg[/img]

We know you, guys, looooove to get new achievements so much - so we warn you from meaningless unlocking plenty of ranks in advance. Be patient and wait for the content update to get even MORE faction points in MORE interesting way than usual PvP! We’re preparing something very exciting for you! But if the factional war is your usual game style or current state of mind… don’t restrain yourself - go on fighting!

Keep in mind, if you kill your mates, you lose your faction points.

[h1]New monsters level system[/h1]

We have changed the way for monsters’ level allocation. Now, all monsters spawn with minimum level, which is determined by specific spawn point. If the monster has been living a fruitful live and nobody hurts him or he somehow managed to kill and eat and digest some unlucky player, then he gets “calories” to grow up to the next level.   

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/d8b07b1e7ee0672ca6230a3c563f5f06ee94370f.jpg[/img]

Thus the more monster lives, the higher level he gets. Higher level for him - more loot & experience for you. Maximum level is restricted by a specific spawn point as well. We believe you’ll be more interested in hunting the most dangerous monsters and seek them in the pristine locations. We will add more spawn points as well.  

Aaaand that’s all, folks! Stay tuned! 

[i]Sincerely yours, 
WTLOnline team[/i]

notes.title: Description of the new patch for version 0.51.1
Description of update 0.51.1
notes.notes:
Today we’ve prepared the update 0.51.1, which adds new content to the game, and corrects a number of issues, which we were informed about by our society. What’s new in update 0.51.1? Read the article!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/7829d125a828e7c7ca066969f8940941ad48cc05.png[/img]

[h1]Hostile NPCs[/h1]

In this update we prepared hostile NPCs for you. Now you’ll have a chance to fight monsters, as well as different bandits and marauders, who don’t belong to any faction. First settlement occupied by such NPCs, is «Sosnovka» village. 

Hostile NPCs are not just bots. As usual game character, they have the possibility to wear different armor and use different weapons, depending on how we customized one or another group of bandits. As usual characters, they have a skill to use weapons. In such a manner, gang leader will have more skills in using weapons, will shoot more precisely and deal more damage compared to his people. 

At the moment, group of bandits that occupied «Sosnovka» village, is targeted to players of Level 25. If your character is of lower Level, be ready for warm welcome.

Fighting against bandits, you have a chance to get their weapons, but you’ll have to repair it. You’ll be able to repair these weapons, or just sell them. In future we will add more interesting content related to hostile NPCs.

[h1]Traveling along outskirts[/h1]

That’s not nearly a secret that Will To Live Online world is endowed with large territories, and traveling from one point to another may take much time, considering the wide range of hazards. In this version we added a large number of «Radio» anomalies to the map; they’ll teleport you along the definite routes, and this will speed up the moving of your character in the limits of one location. However, as it used to be, not all «Radio» anomalies are safe for such trips, and you’ll have to study them yourself. 

We added to game the route map that was some day composed by one of Outskirts explorer. You’ll have to collect all the parts of this map to learn all the safe (and unsafe) routes, which might be used through the «Radio» anomaly.

[h1]New recipes[/h1]

In update 0.51.1 we’ve added new recipes for rounds craft. At this point we’ve added rounds of gage 12 and 9x39. New rounds of gage 12 may deal a great damage to the enemy, and new rounds 9x39 have bigger speed performance, as well as significantly increased penetrating efficiency.

Now you can remelt broken armor plates to iron ingots. 

[h1]Steam Inventory[/h1]

Ability to buy the weapons with custom painting appeared in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/707010/browse/?filter=all]Steam inventory[/url]. This weapon has similar characteristics with usual weapon in the game and does not influence the game balance absolutely. Any character may get all the items, purchased in Steam inventory.  
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/b0bf9ca5277f3c893cfd4c1fa8921d8dbe2a7b93.jpg[/img]

To get the purchased weapons, you shall enter the game as necessary character and visit the merchant of Black Market to get this item. You may find the merchants of Black Market in Solnechny, to the right from Rafik, and in camp of Black Sunset. You may get your purchased item from any of them.
Note: don’t forget to monitor your weapons. This weapon is subject to wear-out, as any usual weapon.

[h1]Localization[/h1]

In update 0.51.1 we added the support of [b]German language[/b]. Should you pay attention that work on German localization is not completed yet, though the bigger part of quests is already translated.

[h1]Balance update[/h1]

- Armour-piercing rounds of gage .45 ACP are added;
- Armour-piercing rounds of gage 5.7x28 are added;
- More tools and wires all around the Outskirts;
- Reduced chance of critical hit for the «Pioneer» rifle;
- Reduced chance of critical hit for the «Thunder» rifle;
- Increased experience for PvP.

[h1]Fixed errors:[/h1]

- Error causing the loss of quest items at death of the character for collection of components in quest for Pharmacist-K is eliminated;
- Error with appearance of tools is eliminated;
- Inaccuracies in quests description were corrected;
- Problem with use of hotkeys of PDA was corrected;
- Errors in locations design were eliminated;
- Problem with ladder in the Bunker was corrected;
- Problems with monsters in the Bunker was solved.
- Fixed about 50 different errors.

notes.title: Description of update 0.51
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Today we prepared the long-awaited update 0.51, which contains more than 20 new different missions, new weapons, new craft and lots of other new opportunities that will be developed in future. 

[h1]List of modifications[/h1]

[b]Weapons[/b]

New submachine gun SMG 90 is added. This weapon is available for engineers in Level 25.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/662ade6ea8c14aac1294239f4e72c74ff847f964.png[/img]

Assault rifle Zastava M-92 is added. It is available for all the classes starting from Level 18. Compared with the rifle Marauder-7, Zastava M92 is less precise, but more destruction-packed.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/388e5d451941e3afe9b0172405072a9e6ed318cb.jpg[/img]

Assault rifle Zastava M70 is added. This is very destruction-packed and relatively precise weapon, which will be available for «mercenary» class only, starting from Level 20. However, it has definite disadvantage: you may equip it with collimator sights and «KITE-1» optic sight only.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/7a9d1b0ee19a459dfd775cd3de45994830cfb3e9.jpg[/img]

SPAS 12 shotgun is added. This Italian weapon is designed for miners, reached Level 23.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/ad7a9f59038ddae3a9f159e7296597caadffa614.jpg[/img]

Special applications scoped rifle – VSS Vintorez. It’ll be available for hunters in Level 20. As distinct from AS VAL, VSS Vintorez is more precise and has magazine case for 10 rounds.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/023a941dcd5ad96a04d00ecac63ac0448c0eb4db.jpg[/img]

New pistol – Glock 17. This pistol will be available starting from Level 16 with possibility to equip it with silencer.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/2d9d2dc8caa3145844e87c4b6444c96211220e41.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/3af7bb4b8326c92cf25fffb7cb6b69b04118e402.jpg[/img]

Springfield 1911 - a new pistol which uses .45 ACP rounds. This gun available for players, who reached 16th level.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/c4b21d46011837506a214ade6d1449fb19a2b08d.jpg[/img]

[b]New quests[/b]

In update 0.51 we added more than 20 different missions; some of them are available for faction players only.

- Advertisement board in Solnechny : 10 quests added, designed for both beginners and advanced players. There are quests available for players of Confederation only.
- Advertisement board in Camp of Black Sunset: 5 quests added designed for Levels 13-20. There are quests available for players of Black Sunset only.
- Quest from Scrowling is added. Quest is available starting from Level 13, but recommended level is 16th.
- New series of 4 quests from Kuzmich is added. These quests are available starting from Level 14, after completion of «Lost device» quest.
- New NPC is added to Zapadnaya (Western) mine, together with 2 new quests available starting from Level 13.

[b]New armor[/b]

We prepared two new helmets for update 0.51: MICH and 6B28.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/c2ea78a0c761b5cab99515245a58e9ff6ce1b258.jpg[/img]

MICH will be available for players of «Black sunset», and 6B28 – for players of «Confederation».

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/72d5134d0897863f98476cd65785f3959f29bf41.jpg[/img]

As well, we prepared new body armor, available for players entered the faction only.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/508a6aeeb4ca9a18b09c1c71cfe9706a6d4c332e.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/cef231cf76c5331d8d9e589c509d76c15f57cbea.png[/img]

Despite the fact that new body armor is related to medium armor, any character, reached Level 27, may wear it. We will closely follow the situation with new body armors, because appearance of such all-purpose armor may amend forces posture and balance.

[b]Rounds production[/b]

In update 0.51 we will present the new type of craft – rounds production. This process is quite complicated and laborious, and it’ll cover all the stages of round production:

- Gunpowder production;
- Production of bullet and lead;
- Shell production;
- And, finally, production of the round itself.

All the crafted rounds will be more powerful than those sold in the shop. Thus, new rounds will make your weapon more efficient.

[b]Stimulators production[/b]

After completion of Kuzmich’s quests, you will get the appliance and recipe for production of «Awl» stimulator. Now you are able to produce stimulator on your own, using the character’s inventory. As well, new stimulator named «Tough guy» will be available, which increases force indicator of character by 2 units. It has step-by-step effect; however, force indicator of character shall not exceed 10 units.

[b]New monsters[/b]

Small symbiont moved in the wastelands. Stay alert!

[b]Turrets and NPC[/b]

Unfortunately, we couldn’t get hostile NPCs done in full extent by the release of update 0.51. Nevertheless, NPC-guards will appear to help turrets in all the important points in this version. They’ll fight the peace-breakers. Probably, this solution is temporary, but it is very interesting to see, how the society responds to it, and how NPCs manage their mission. We will watch the situation, and hostile NPCs will appear in future patches in the frameworks of development of 0.51 thread.

[b]PDA[/b]

In update 0.51 PDA got new function – possibility to maintain the list of friends and enemies. Players added to the list of enemies will be highlighted with red color, and friends – with blue one.

[b]Clans[/b]

- We added the opportunity to appoint the clan deputy.

[b]Balance[/b]

- Experience for killing players is increased.
- Damage of SP-5 bullets is increased.
- Penetrating efficiency and damage of bullets SP-6 are increased.
- Experience for killing bugs is increased.
- Experience for killing flame spiders is increased.
- Aimcone at hip-fire is changed.
- «Leshiy» quest from Kuzmich is now available starting from Level 18 instead of Level 20.
- «Pioneer» rifle was moved to Level 23.
- Armor of helmet SSH-40 is decreased. Helmet is moved to Level 18.
- Wolf-357 now requires 18th level.

[b]Models[/b]

- Model of Shpagin SMG-41 is improved.
- Quality of male characters models was improved. Now hairdo of male characters looks well-worked, and selection of hair color works more properly.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/07de4445a5db01fe7819b166445ded777cb77565.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/fe2138af19aa9ec2d1c20e98631a5f4090290bf1.jpg[/img]

[b]New loot [/b]

Now you may find batteries in abandoned vehicles and buildings; you may get lead from batteries. To get the lead, you shall apply hammer to icon of battery in the inventory.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

- Problems with character customization are solved.
- Problems with some crashes of game client are solved.

[b]Other[/b]
- Brightness of the red dot sights was reduced.
- Added NVIDIA Highlights support.

notes.title: Update 0.51: news from the field
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’ve already told you about our future plans in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/WTLOnline/announcements/detail/1644257484254866919]previous news[/url]. Today we would like to share the most recent details about oncoming update 0.51. But first of all, it should be mentioned that we’ve made several important improvements for version 0.50.4, and, despite it, development of 0.51 goes ahead, though a bit belatedly.

[h1]New monsters[/h1]

We prepared a new monster for update 0.51. We call it «Small symbiont». This monster is very weak, but very interesting; it will dwell in ruins located in the desert. This type of monsters is very sociable, they like hunting travelers in packs. At that, they prefer very close contact with the victim 😉. Watch video to see how «Small symbiont» looks like.

https://youtu.be/II4W-nssg3g

[h1]NPC-Enemies[/h1]

Work on this type of enemies is in process, and we reached definite success. To our regret, more than likely we will not be able to implement the mechanics of checkpoints occupation in the first release of version 0.51, but nevertheless we believe that all players will be interested in playing with opponents like this. We prepared new models for such NPC, and at the moment we are developing their animation and behavior model.
  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/63a1eda58f5f9eb6cb12eae0ba70b58394e02fbc.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/d21ff8cccc5780af5712e093c1b4e133b25d1951.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/252347637fb0443ad269c33d1419941ea9806223.jpg[/img]

We plan to settle small groups of bandits in the outskirts in update 0.51; they will be hostile towards all the players. In future such groups will have their leaders, and fighting with them you will be able to get their weapons, bullets and other supplies. 

When all the mechanics of fight against NPC are debugged and adjusted, we will be able to start the work on checkpoints occupation.

[h1]New weapons[/h1]

We plan to present new weapons in update 0.51. For instance, SMG90 will appear in the game. It is designed for engineers of Level 25. 
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/662ade6ea8c14aac1294239f4e72c74ff847f964.png[/img]

This submachine gun is one of the most desirable weapons for us, as at the moment «engineer» class poorly shows itself in some game scenario. As we informed before, new submachine gun will be designed for players of Level 25. It will have very high rate of fire and comparatively good performance against armor. At the moment, we completed the work on the animation of weapon, and keeping working on its adjustment and balance.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/NUPFBSYcoOxLgggy3i/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Quests[/h1]

Beside new weapons, NPC and new armor, we plan to prepare number of new quests for characters of different levels, but first of all, we paid attention to players of Levels 13-16. For instance, advertisement board will appear in the game, where you will be able to take repeatable quests. This approach will let you gain more money and experience, in contrast to simple monster killing. What’s more, new quests will be added to the game; they will be available for players, joined the faction only.


Version 0.51 presents lots of game mechanics and opportunities that will be developed and introduced step by step in series of updates 0.51 (0.51.1, 0.51.2, etc). We express our gratitude to our core fans from all over the world – your support is very important for us! 

Stay with us and follow the news!

notes.notes:
Update 0.49 brings in the game a new location, which allows players to pump to level 35, new weapons, interesting tasks and, of course, improves the appearance, but let's talk about everything in order.

It should be noted that 0.49 is a major update that prepares the game for the early access release on Steam!

[h1]New location "Swamp"[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/4T7zWvKSqo3NKcqQDH/giphy.gif[/img]

"Swamp" - is the northern lands of wastelands, in which players will face new dangers, monsters and quests.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lJg2fJuHywNB4BCXXl/giphy.gif[/img]

In this location you will be able to meet five new creatures, as well as to find Kuzmich's brother, nicknamed Leshiy. If you are at a proper stage of progress, perhaps Leshiy will share with you his thoughts on the topic of the Сatastrophe, the conflict of factions and the origin of some monsters.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/8UGoQtS45RJrTmTamN/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1lyRGgNuCcN19eBjOf/giphy.gif[/img]

We recommend that you visit Kuzmich, so that he can guide you in search of new adventures.

[h1]New weapon[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/6b1041125b6d13784c438712987e6935dd6a5a0e.jpg[/img]

[h1]New models[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/73d9590746def1a96c2aa8fd8f200dccf7316c13.jpg[/img]

In addition to creating models of new monsters, we are also working on improving existing models. This time, mutant-rats were subjected to an update.

[h1]Customization[/h1]

The customization interface has been improved. Also, a new face for female characters was added.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/17d8633003e4ad09a99a7b12d864a44431e31c6e.png[/img]

[h1]Backpacks[/h1]

Starting with this version, each of the character classes will differ visually at the expense of individual backpacks.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/469b001db6d11ee30c7fb33585ae4b355333bb90.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hunting[/h1]

Starting with version 0.49, all players need to hunt. In the wasteland, now you can meet a rabbit, a fox and even a deer. These are ordinary animals that are not mutants, and they are not aggressive towards the player.

Starting with this version, the meat of any monsters will now poison the body with radiation, while the meat of ordinary animals is not. Thus, the value of eating in wastelands rises to a new level..

[h1]Balance[/h1]

This update brings a number of tangible changes in the balance of some locations, monsters and the characters themselves.

For example, the location of the "Bunker" was revised for the balance sheet. Particularly strong changes were made to the jelly: they became more dangerous, but at the same time, it became much easier to cope with them.

The "Cave of Cockroaches" and the quest "Cockroaches spawn" were revised. Cockroaches now react to the player on a smaller radius of removal, and the number of cockroaches in the location is reduced. We will continue to monitor this location.

The changes also affected the large cave spider in the quarry: it was significantly understated in level, which makes it easier to hunt for small groups of players.

Also impact effect of "Antirad" was improved actions and the night vision device is now available to all classes from the 16th level, and to the class "engineer" it is available already at the 15th level.

The maximum carry-over weight of characters now increases only to level 25. A further increase in the weight to be transferred will be adjusted by means of skill points.

• The distribution of character stats is now available in the PDA and the doctor is no longer required for this.
• Added new recipes for cooking decoctions at the stake.
• When wood is burned, charcoal now remains in the fire.
• Weapon recoil system was completely redesigned.

notes.title: Update 0.48 is available on the game servers!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821281/bf682d8ff43a1a08345e9c401cf2bb7548dc6db7.jpg[/img]

The update 0.48 is essential to Will to Live universe. It features division of all players into two hostile factions: The Confederation and the Black Sunset. As we said [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/WTLOnline/announcements/detail/1641994274142491186]before[/url], the factions will unlock for you after you complete "The Protective Dome" quest. As you select one of the hostile parties, you won't be able to visit the opposite faction's camp anymore. If you say no to both of them, your character will remain factionless.

• We completely removed the Karma system, as well.
• Turrets to prevent wars were installed near camps.
• All characters of your faction will be identified as friendly, their names will turn green.
• Killing your faction's player character will reduce your reputation with this faction. If it drops to zero, you will be considered a traitor, and your character's name will turn red.
• If your faction reputation is between 0 and 50%, your name will turn yellow to warn others that you're moving towards being a traitor. In the future, all faction traitors will lose access to all faction camps and towns.
• Killing traitors will increase your reputation with your faction.

Hunters will receive a new Coyote rifle at level 13. This rifle links Fox rifle and Mosin–Nagant rifle. Low-level players will be able to use Squirrel rifle, available to you since level 2.
Redesigned the interaction with objects. Now you will have to press and hold the F key ("Use") in order to search monsters, boxes etc. You may now charge your MRD-1 and MHD-1 without removing them, provided that you have batteries. It should improve your combat experience with these devices.

Starting from v.0.48, we are moving all sound effects to FMOD library. Compared to the standard Unreal Engine library, FMOD allows higher quality surround sound, better environmental sound reactions, and clearer distant sounds. Thus, all higher quality sound effects of the game will significantly improve your gaming experience.

We have also optimized the network code to fix the problems of previous versions of the game.

[h1]List of modifications[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
-        Faction selection option was added. Available to you after completing "The Protective Dome" quest.
-        Removed the Karma system.
-        Added automatic turrets to prevent wars near spawn points.
-        Interaction with objects (monster and box search) now takes time.
-        The Black Dusk camp now has their own weapon master.

[b]Quests[/b]

- Glum, Gosha and Valera "Bonus" now give more new quests.

[b]Weapons[/b]

- Added Squirrel rifle using .22LR ammo. It becomes available at level 2.
- Added Coyote rifle, available to hunters at level 13.

[b]Balance[/b]

- Increased damage dealt by Mosin–Nagant rifle.
- Increased damage dealt by Pioneer rifle.
- You don't have to remove mobile respawn and healing devices to charge them. You must have the suitable batteries in your inventory and stay in the device's active zone.

[b]Sound[/b]

- Replaced Unreal Engine 4 with FMOD sound engine.

[b]Optimization[/b]

- The network traffic was optimized.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

- Fixed a lot of minor glitches.
- Corrected locations design problems.
